steps: in a medium-hot iron skillet , stirring constantly , toast pecans until fragrant ~ be careful they don't burn ! set aside to cool , then chop coarsely or ~ place sweet potatoes in large saucepan add enough water to cover cover saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat reduce the heat to medium-high and cook at a low boil until tender , about 10 minutes drain , transfer to large bowl , and let cool , about 5-10 minutes meanwhile , whisk together the vinegar , orange juice , maple syrup , mustard , salt , pepper , and cinnamon in a bowl slowly whisk in canola oil until well blended set aside add the apple , dried cranberries , and pecans to the sweet potatoes toss gently with the dressing serve warm or chilled

name: Super duper sweet potatoes
ingredients: fresh sweet potatoes|orange juice|brown sugar|orange rind|water|butter|salt|nuts|small marshmallow
steps: spray medium baking dish preheat oven to 350 degrees slice sweet potatoes in 1 / 4 inch slices arrange sweet potatoes in baking dish combine orange juice , brown sugar , orange rind , water , butter , and salt pour evenly over sweet potatoes sprinkle on nuts , if desired cover and bake , basting occasionally , until potatoes are tender , approximately 30 minutes remove lid during last 10 minutes of baking and may sprinkle over marshmallows at this time if desired

name: Super duper turtle brownies
ingredients: caramels|sweetened condensed milk|butter|sugar|eggs|cocoa|milk|vanilla|salt|baking powder|chocolate chips|pecans|flour
steps: preheat oven to 350 melt caramels and sweetened condensed milk together over low heat , stirring frequently melt butter beat sugar and eggs , add cocoa , milk , vanilla , and melted butter add flour , salt , and baking powder stir in all chocolate chips and half of pecans put 2 / 3 of batter into greased 9x13 pan and bake for 12 minutes remove and pour caramel over brownies sprinkle remaining pecans on top , and spoon rest of browine batter over tope and spread out cut through browines with a butter knife to marble caramel bake for 25-30 minutes and remove from oven to cool for about one hour , then refrigerate to cool completely before cutting

name: Super duper yummy coleslaw
ingredients: cabbage|carrots|celery seed|vegetable oil|sugar|vinegar|salt|ground mustard|onion
steps: in a large bowl , toss cabbage , carrots and celery seed place the remaining ingredients in a blender ot food processor cover and process until combined pour over cabbage mixture and toss to coat cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours serve with a slotted spoon

name: Super easy cheesy enchiladas
ingredients: cheese|cream cheese|garlic powder|instant minced onion|corn tortillas|enchilada sauce
steps: first , you want to mix the first four ingredients together until they are really well combined seriously , you will not see any little shreds of cheese and it will have the texture of stiff play dough preheat your oven to 350 and grab a pan i used an 11x7 inch oval baking dish , but you can also use an 8inch square pour about 1 / 4 of the enchilada sauce into the bottom of the pan and swirl the pan until the bottom is coated reach in with your clean hands and grab about 2 tablespoons of cheese mixture in your hands and shape into a log roll a tortilla around this log and place in the pan repeat for the rest of the cheese and tortillas pour the rest of the sauce on top , spreading it to cover sprinkle the last 1 / 2 cup of cheese on top , and place in the oven bake 20-30 minutes or until hot and bubbly for oamc: freeze before cooking , thaw in refrigerator and bake according to directions

name: Super easy tasty guacamole
ingredients: avocados|salsa|garlic salt|pepper
steps: remove the avocado from its skin and start mashing with a fork in a bowl sprinkle with desired amount of garlic salt and pepper add desired amount of salsa i guarantee this guac will taste great , and you can mix it up in about 1 minute enjoy

name: Super easy delicious coleslaw
ingredients: coleslaw mix|onion|mayonnaise|vinegar|sugar
steps: mix cole slaw mix and onion together in separate bowl , whisk together mayo , vinegar and sugar pour over slaw mix and onion for best results , let sit overnight

name: Super easy delicious fudge
ingredients: salted butter|semi-sweet chocolate chips|sweetened condensed milk|vanilla|chocolate-covered mint candies
steps: spray a large bread pan with a non-stick spray also , prepare a double boiler by getting the water boiling also , this is a recipe which requires constant stirring , so have a spoon handy ! in the double boiler , add the butter , vanilla and sweetened condensed milk and melt together it keeps you from burning the chocolate by providing an even heat source once the mixture is blended and easy to stir , add the chocolate chips , stirring constantly stir until the mixture is glossy and well blended with no chunks pour into the prepared bread pan if desired , insert andes chocolate mints throughout the fudge by pushing it into the top let cool completely before serving enjoy !

name: Super easy and inexpensive chicken pot pie
ingredients: pie crusts|veg-all|cream of chicken soup|chicken breasts|salt|pepper
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees mix together veg-all , soup and chicken in large bowl season with salt and pepper spoon into frozen pie crust and top with second pie crust bake at 350 for 35 minutes or until top crust is brown all ingredients are already cooked

name: Super easy speckle trout
ingredients: trout fillets|lemon juice|butter
steps: clean trout properly cut to the size you prefer to eat put enough butter on bottom of pan and let bubble lay trout , skin side down , in pan flip when necessary squeeze lemon juice over trout fillets

name: Super easy sausage rolls
ingredients: spicy pork sausage|pizza dough|italian seasoning|garlic powder|onion powder|black pepper
steps: preheat oven to temperature suggested on pizza dough can unroll refrigerated pizza dough onto countertop pinch off pieces of uncooked sausage and place liberally all over dough , including corners and edges sprinkle liberally with garlic powder , onion powder , italian seasoning and black pepper , to taste roll up dough , jelly-roll fashion , and slice into 1" pieces place pieces flat side down onto ungreased cookie sheet about 2" apart bake approximately 12 to 14 minutes until a nice golden brown my kids enjoy these warm with sour cream or maple syrup

name: Super easy 2 hour homemade rolls
ingredients: flour|sugar|egg|vegetable oil|salt|yeast|water
steps: mix all ingredients together in a large bowl and let sit for 1 hour add enough flour to handle , make into balls and put in greased baking dish let rise 1 more hour bake at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes

name: Super easy 4 ingredient lace cookies
ingredients: brown sugar|butter|honey|flour
steps: put 2 tbsp of brown sugar , 2 tbsp of butter and 1 1 / 2 tbsp of honey into a sauce pan and melt it once melted , whisk in 2 tbsp of flour until smooth then drop 1 tsp of the batter onto a parchment lined baking sheet and bake for 6 min at 375f or until they are noticably golden brown all over the batter spreads and bubbles into beautiful cookies once they have set enough to transfer , you can pick them up with your fingers and move them to a cooling rack to cool until crisp and make sandwiches out of them with buttercream or you can shape them into mini ice cream bowls or cones

name: Super easy 6 ingredient stroganoff
ingredients: wide egg noodles|ground beef|beef gravy|lipton onion soup mix|cream of mushroom soup|sour cream
steps: brown meat and drain add the last 4 ingredients to meat , simmer 10 minute serve over cooked egg noodles

name: Super easy and delicious fiesta chicken soup
ingredients: chicken broth|salsa|red kidney beans|cooked chicken|baby spinach|mozzarella cheese
steps: in a large saucepan bring broth and salsa to a boil add beans and chicken , heat through stir in spinach , cook just until wilted top with cheese if desired

name: Super easy and delicious peanut butter ice cream pie
ingredients: crunchy peanut butter|whipped topping|vanilla ice cream|graham cracker crumb crust
steps: in a large bowl , mix together the peanut butter , whipped topping and ice cream pour into either a graham cracker or chocolate crust , whichever is preferred

name: Super easy and good nacho casserole
ingredients: olive oil|sweet bell pepper|lean ground beef|garlic salt|prepared pizza crust|medium hot salsa|taco cheese|black olives|scallions
steps: heat oven to 375f coat 13x9x2 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray in a large skillet , heat the oil over medium high heat add the sweet peppers , ground beef and garlic salt cook , stirring to break up clumps of beef , until the peppers are softened and beef is no longer pink , about 5 minutes carefully drain off any excess fat from the skillet remove the pizza dough from the tubes cut the dough crosswise into 1 / 2 inch slices , then cut each slice into 4 pieces in a large bowl , toss together the dough pieces and salsa add the cooked meat mixture , 2 cups of the cheese , and the olives scrap mixture into the baking dish sprinkle the remaining cheese on top bake in 375f oven for 30 minutes sprinkle the scallions evenly over the top bake another 5 minutes

name: Super easy and quick three bean salad
ingredients: dark red kidney beans|cannellini beans|black beans|yellow bell pepper|balsamic vinegar|italian dressing|sugar|garlic powder
steps: drain and rinse beans place beans in a large bowl and add the remaining ingredients toss , cover and refrigerate for 3 hours before serving

name: Super easy and spicy pot roast crock pot
ingredients: boneless chuck roast|campbell's condensed beef broth|tomato soup|rotel tomatoes
steps: cut roast into large chunks and place in crock pot mix soups and rotel together and pour over roast cook on low approximately 8 hours or on high for 5 hours , depending on your crock pot i use an older pot that has settings from 1 to 6 -- and i set mine on 4

name: Super easy and tasty beef stroganoff
ingredients: round steaks|all-purpose flour|butter|salt|pepper|water|cream of mushroom soup|sour cream|milk|cooked egg noodles|fresh parsley
steps: cut the steak into 2 1 / 2 inch strips coat the steak with flour and brown the meat in batches in the butter in a large skillet stirring occasionally add the salt , pepper , water , and cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until the meat is almost tender stirring occasionally stir in the soup and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes or until the meat is tender stir in the sour cream and milk cook until heated through serve over the hot noodles

name: Super easy and tasty creamy corn pudding
ingredients: eggs|unsalted butter|sour cream|jiffy corn muffin mix|cream-style corn|whole kernel corn|ground nutmeg
steps: mix all ingredients in a bowl pour mixture into a greased 8x8 pan for approximately 50 minutes at 350 degrees

name: Super easy and yummy chicken enchiladas
ingredients: chicken breast|yellow onion|cheese|diced green chilies|98% fat-free cream of chicken soup|light sour cream|flour tortillas|taco seasoning mix|poultry seasoning
steps: cook chicken with poultry seasoning cool completely shred chicken in food processor saute onion in a saucepan add chicken , 1 / 2 of the green chilis and taco seasoning and cook for two minutes remove from heat and add two cups cheese prepare sauce in a medium bowl: combine soup , sour cream and the other half can of green chilis in a 9 x 13 pan , place 1 cup of sauce place 1 / 8 to 1 / 10 of chicken mixture in each flour tortilla and roll up and place in pan with seams down pour remaining sauce over enchiladas and sprinkle top with remaining two cups cheese bake at 375 degrees for 2025 minutes

name: Super easy and yummy corn chowder
ingredients: onion|green bell pepper|smoked sausage|butter|flour|evaporated milk|potatoes|whole kernel corn|water|olive oil
steps: put olive oil in large pot saute onion and green bell pepper add water , potatos , corn and sausage cook until potatos are soft in seperate bowl melt butter with flour to make your roux add roux and evaporated milk and seasonings simmer until thickened enjoy !

name: Super easy and yummy doughnuts
ingredients: refrigerated biscuits|oil|granulated sugar|powdered sugar|cinnamon
steps: heat oil to 375 degrees fahrenheit in skillet put granulated sugar and cinnamon in a quart or gallon size plastic bag shake to mix then set aside to sugar the fried doughnuts put the powdered sugar in a separate quart or gallon plastic bag and then set aside to use to sugar the fried doughnuts open the tube of biscuits and separate each one , then poke a hole in the center of each with your finger and then carefully stretch it open some place each piece in the hot oil and fry until puffy and golden brown turn with a fork and fry the other side until golden lift out and drain on paper towels promptly shake them , one by one , in the cinnamon sugar and then in the powdered sugar

name: Super easy appetizer tomato and pesto crostini
ingredients: puff pastry|cherry tomatoes|bocconcini|pesto sauce
steps: defrost the puff pastry , and cut into 16 squares cook in moderate oven for 10 minutes so that the pastry is slightly golden and starting to puff on each square , place a bocconini slice , followed by a cherry tomato and a small blob of pesto put back into oven and cook a further 10 minutes until the boconncini have started to melt serve immediately

name: Super easy apple cake
ingredients: yellow cake mix|apple pie filling|water|cinnamon|allspice|brown sugar|pecans|butter|flour
steps: preheat oven to 350 grease 9x13 pan whisk cake mix to remove lumps whisk in cinnamon and allspice stir in apple pie filling , and just enough water to make a smooth batter spread into pan mix together butter , brown sugar , flour and pecans , and sprinkle evenly over top of apple / cake mix bake for 30-40 minutes , checking after 30 for doneness sometimes it takes a bit longer

name: Super easy apple dip
ingredients: cream cheese|brown sugar|vanilla
steps: cream the sugar and cream cheese until light then mix in the vanilla chill 1 hour enjoy !

name: Super easy baba ghanouj ricardo larrive
ingredients: eggplant|garlic|olive oil|salt and pepper
steps: with the rack in the middle position , preheat the oven to 350f line a baking sheet with parchment paper place the eggplant cut side down on the baking sheet roast until the flesh is very tender and pulls away easily from the skin , about 1 hour depending on the eggplant's size let cool meanwhile , cut the place the cloves in a square of aluminum foil fold up the edges of the foil and crimp together to form a tightly sealed packet roast alongside the eggplant until tender , about 20 minutes let cool pure the cloves by pressing them through a garlic press using a spoon , scoop the flesh from the eggplant and place it in the bowl of a food processor add the garlic pure and oil process until smooth season with salt and pepper serve with mini pitas

name: Super easy baked chicken breasts
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|olive oil|seasoning salt|black pepper|parmesan cheese|paprika|dried parsley flakes
steps: preheat oven to 375f oil or spray 9x13 baking pan pat chicken dry and place in the pan drizzle or brush with olive oil and sprinkle with the remaining ingredients in order of recipe the ingredient amounts given are approximate ! use more or less to suit your taste and to give a nice even coating of each ingredient on the chicken pieces i never measure for this recipe , i just eyeball it feel free to use any seasoning salt you like instead of the bon apetit or substitute your favorite herb for the parsley flakes you can also add to or reduce the number of chicken breasts according to your family size i often cook extra to make sandwiches the next day this is more of a technique to try than a recipe ! bake for about 30 minutes , until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear i usually microwave 4 medium potatoes for 10 minutes and then put them in the oven at same time as the chicken to finish cooking-makes quick baked potatoes i serve veggies , salad and bread for a nice , easy weeknight dinner

name: Super easy baked chicken parmesan for two
ingredients: parmesan cheese|italian seasoned breadcrumbs|salt|egg|boneless skinless chicken breasts|spaghetti sauce|mozzarella cheese
steps: preheat the oven to 400 degrees f lightly spray a pie plate or a foil-lined baking sheet with cooking spray set aside combine parmesan , breadcrumbs , and salt in a shallow dish place egg in a separate shallow dish dip each side of each chicken breast in egg , then dredge in the breadcrumb mixture place on prepared pan bake for 18 minutes , flipping once halfway through , until done take the chicken out and switch the oven to broil divide the sauce evenly and pour over each piece of chicken sprinkle evenly with the mozzarella cheese broil 2 minutes or until the cheese melts

name: Super easy baked ham
ingredients: cooked ham|salt and pepper
steps: preheat oven to 350f and make sure the racks are all the way on the bottom so there is plenty of room for the ham bring ham in packaging to sink and have a pan big enough to hold it nearby i find a 9"x13" baking pan works great make sure your pan is at least an inch deep take ham out of wrapper and rinse it with cool water if you think it feels icky then find the plastic doohickey on the large cut end and remove it at this point you can trim off some of the fat if you would like i usually don't , as most of it renders out into the pan or is very easy to cut around place ham in pan with large cut side down stab with the business end of a probe style thermometer this is the kind which has a long metal skewer on one end , a long cable , and a box which has all the controls and readouts make sure the probe goes through a large area of meat , not fat , and doesn't hit one of the bones down the center of the ham set your thermometer to alert you when the ham reaches 140f when your oven has reached 350f , put the ham in wait until the thermometer alerts you then remove the ham from the oven remove the probe , and either start slicing or put on a pretty platter and let your family / guests ooh and ahh :) do not panic , the meat is juicy , i promise simply cut the skin off where it is really crispy and get to the meat underneath also: if you do not have a probe style meat thermometer , or need an idea of timing for preparing the rest of your meal , an already cooked ham will reheat to 140f in approximately 15 minutes per pound so a 12 pound ham will take 3 hours ish and finally: i like to carve off the leftovers and separate into 1 pound amounts i then put these into labeled quart sized freezer bags and freeze for casseroles , pasta , or beans another night the bone can be put into a labeled gallon sized freezer bag , and then thawed for yummy beans another night

name: Super easy banana mini nilla southern pudding
ingredients: banana cream instant pudding|2% low-fat milk|cool whip|vanilla wafers|bananas
steps: 1 wisk pudding and milk together for 2 minutes then let sit for 3 minutes 2 mix 1 / 2 of cool whip with pudding 3 layer: wafers , banana , cool whip , pudding--into 4 layers 4 chill at least 1 hour

name: Super easy banana popsicle
ingredients: banana|wooden popsicle sticks
steps: cut bananas in half push a popsicle stick in one end of the banana , making sure it doesn't poke out the side when you do wrap each half in saran wrap or non-stick foil and put in plastic ziplock bag freeze until solid unwrap and give to a happy kid these can be dipped in peanut butter and coated with wheat germ or chopped nuts -- can also be used for fondue -- just use your imagination ! 1 banana= 2 popsicles

name: Super easy barbecue chicken drumsticks thighs
ingredients: chicken drumsticks|chicken thighs|barbecue sauce
steps: part one in 1 or 2 oblong storage containers pour 1 / 2 - 1 cup of bbq sauce on bottom of each container and tilt container until bbq sauce evenly coats bottom part two put chicken inside dutch oven or other large pot with lid fill with water until water is about 2 inches higher than chicken bring to boil and cook for 15 - 20 minutes - no longer or chicken will be tough pour chicken & water into colander to drain water leaving chicken in colander turn on cool water and while holding chicken leg or thigh under water pull off skin & any fat place each piece into the container pour rest of the bbq sauce evenly over the chicken making sure to cover all the meat cover container and put into fridge either for the rest of the day or overnight because the chicken is hot it absorbs more of the bbq sauce flavoring it doesn't go bad part three preheat oven to 400 degrees place coated pieces on greased oblong pan bake for 40 minutes

name: Super easy beef and pasta bake
ingredients: minced beef|oil|onion|garlic cloves|carrot|chunky tomato pasta sauce|beef stock|tomato sauce|oregano|spiral shaped pasta|cheese|coarse unseasoned bread crumbs|mustard powder
steps: preheat oven to 180c brown mince in a large pan , remove and drain juices add oil to pan and cook onion , garlic , & carrot until just tender return mince to the pan along with pasta sauce , beef stock , oregano and pasta , simmer covered for around 10min or till mixture thickens transfer to an oven proof dish , sprinkle cheese , bread crumbs and mustard powder over top bake for 15min or till brown on top

name: Super easy beef brisket
ingredients: beef brisket|onion soup mix|barbecue sauce
steps: top a cookie sheet with a long length of heavy duty foil place brisket fat side down in the middle of the foil sprinkle brisket with soup mix , then top with bbq sauce fold aluminum foil over brisket and fold closed , then seal ends tightly bake in 275 degree oven for five hours there is no need to baste , turn or check on the brisket remove from oven and allow meat to rest for 15 minutes before serving

name: Super easy beef onion dip
ingredients: cream cheese|cream of mushroom soup|green onion|dried beef|salt
steps: using kitchen scissors snip green onions finely creating onion ribbons anywhere between 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 of a cup again using scissors , cut the beef , forming ribbons , then cut the beef ribbons with scissors across , forming small squares place softened cream cheese and the soup into a mixing bowl and blend for about 2 minutes until creamy add snipped onion and blend again 1 minute with chosen seasoning extras , although this dip is also quite good unseasoned as well fold in snipped beef with a spoon or fork , do not use mixer at this point chill your delicious creation for 3-4 hours then spread on crackers , pita , whatever

name: Super easy beef roast
ingredients: beef roast|lipton beefy onion soup mix|water|red wine|salt and pepper|potatoes|carrot
steps: place roast in roasting pan add soup mix , water , wine , salt and pepper cover with lid or foil roast in oven at 350f for approximately 3 hours baste meat every 30 minutes to keep meat moist after 2 hours add potatoes and carrots cover with lid or foil again do not baste meat during this last hour when done remove from oven but keep covered for 10-15 minutes remove meat , potatoes , and carrots from pan for a thicker sauce place roaster on stove top and bring to a boil boil for 2 minutes or until desired thickness no need to add flour or water slice meat and serve with potatoes , carrots and sauce

name: Super easy beef stroganoff
ingredients: lean ground beef|diced onion|reduced-sodium chicken broth|cream of mushroom soup|dijon mustard|garlic|whole wheat egg noodles|light sour cream|pepper
steps: brown the ground beef in a large skillet , and drain , if necessary add onion , garlic and saute add chicken broth , mustard and pepper stir in cream of mushroom soup add egg noodles simmer for 10 minutes on medium / low heat , or until noodles are tender stir in sour cream , serve and enjoy !

name: Super easy black bean burritos
ingredients: black beans|salsa|cooked brown rice|flour tortillas|lettuce|tomatoes|avocado
steps: combine the black beans , salsa , and the rice in a saucepan and simmer for 5 minutes remove from heat , cover , and let sit for 5 minutes in an ungreased skillet , heat a tortilla until warm spread a line of the bean mixture down the center top with lettuce , tomato , avocado , and more salsa if desired roll up and enjoy !

name: Super easy black bean soup
ingredients: black beans|salsa|beef consomme|water|cumin|diced green chilies
steps: mix together beans , salsa , consomme , water and cumin in large stock pot puree 1 / 3 of bean mixture in blender , add bean puree back into pot add diced green chilies to pot cook over medium high heat till boiling turn heat down and simmer , covered , for ten minutes serve with a dollop of sour cream , if desired

name: Super easy bolognese sauce
ingredients: ground beef|bulk sausage|garlic|dried oregano|all-purpose flour|heavy cream|2% low-fat milk|wine|crushed tomatoes|diced tomatoes|tomato paste|beef broth|brown sugar
steps: brown the ground beef and sausage together on medium-high heat halfway through browning , add garlic and dried oregano continue to brown all the way through , do not drain fat sprinkle flour over meat and stir until flour dissolves and disappears add heavy cream and milk , simmer until it all evaporates repeat with wine add in all the tomatoes , the tomato paste , and broth simmer on low for close to 2 hours stir in brown sugar

name: Super easy bread
ingredients: bread|butter|chili flakes|oregano
steps: toast the bread spread butter on both the slices sprinkle chilli flakes& oregano according to taste ! your super easy bread is ready !

name: Super easy breakfast shake
ingredients: bananas|yogurt|powdered soy protein concentrate|carrot juice
steps: add all ingredients to blender blend well enjoy

name: Super easy broccoli mac n cheese
ingredients: whole wheat pasta|red bell pepper|frozen cut broccoli in cheese sauce|cooked boneless skinless chicken breasts|nonfat milk|cayenne pepper|plain breadcrumbs|parmesan cheese|italian seasoning|olive oil
steps: preheat the oven to 375 degrees grease a 13-inch x 9-inch baking dish cook the pasta as directed on the package , adding the bell pepper during the last three minutes of cook time drain the pasta and return it to the saucepan meanwhile , cook the broccoli and cheese sauce as directed on the package stir the cooked broccoli mixture , chicken , milk and cayenne pepper into the pasta pour the pasta mixture into the baking dish in a small bowl , stir together the bread crumbs , parmesan cheese and italian seasoning stir in the olive oil using a fork sprinkle the bread crumb mixture over the top of the pasta mixture bake for 15-20 minutes , or until the top is golden brown and the pasta is hot

name: Super easy candied walnuts
ingredients: walnuts|honey|butter
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees f on a cookie sheet "with sides" place a piece of parchment paper in the bottom of the pan add walnuts and spread out into one layer drizzle honey over all of the nuts add slices of butter and spread equally over top of the honey & nuts bake for 5 minutes or until butter and honey melts remove from oven and stir nut mixture , then flatten uniformly coated nuts bake for 5 more minutes remove from oven and stir nut mixture , then flatten uniformly coated nuts remove from oven and flatten nuts letting them cool when cooled , about 10-15 minutes later , break them up enjoy !

name: Super easy canned bean stew
ingredients: carrots|onion|beans|broth|diced tomatoes|garlic powder
steps: sautee the onion and carrots in some cooking spray add the broth , the drained beans , and the canned tomatoes season with spices simmer for 10 minutes

name: Super easy caramel corn
ingredients: popcorn|marshmallows|butter|brown sugar
steps: pop half a cup of popcorn in your preferred method of popping corn ! :) place remaining ingredients marshmallows , butter and brown sugar for 30 seconds at a time in the microwave stir to mix well pour over popcorn and mix evenly with a fork spread into single layer on wax paper allow to dry completely before storing in an airtight container

name: Super easy cheese and spinach stuffed mushrooms
ingredients: fresh mushrooms|frozen chopped spinach|cream cheese|feta cheese|green onion|garlic salt|ground pepper|parmesan cheese
steps: preheat oven to 350f wipe mushrooms clean with a damp towel thaw spinach and squeeze out as much moisture as possible in mixing bowl combine all ingredients except mushrooms and parmesan mix well fill mushroom caps with mixture and place on cookie sheet sprinkle parmesan cheese on top bake 15-20 minutes serve warm

name: Super easy cheese ball
ingredients: cream cheese|meat
steps: dice up the meat and mix with cream cheese form into a ball or just leave it in the bowl serve with ritz crackers too easy and yummy you can find this dried honey ham meat with the lunch meats like 69cents a package

name: Super easy cheese crackers
ingredients: butter|extra-sharp cheddar cheese|plain flour|rice krispies|red pepper|salt
steps: in a bowl work together butter , cheese , salt and pepper until soft put in food processor , add flour and krispies pulse until dough forms into a ball line cookie sheet with foil pinch off small amounts of dough and roll into little balls place balls onto cookies sheet and mash down flat with fingers you may take a fork and push into to make lines in crackers bake at 350 f for about 8-10 minutes until light brown let cool before removing them from the cookie sheet

name: Super easy cheese enchiladas
ingredients: extra-sharp cheddar cheese|corn tortillas|vegetable oil|onion|enchilada sauce|chili without beans
steps: quickly cook tortillas in hot oil until softened drain well on paper towels set aside saute onion in oil until limp drain place one stick of cheese and some onion onto each tortilla roll up place seam side down in lightly greased casserole combine enchilada sauce and chili in a medium bowl pour over tortillas bake at 375 until done

name: Super easy cheese sticks
ingredients: mozzarella string cheese|spring roll wrappers
steps: unwrap cheese & set aside , take a wrapper & starting in the corner place stick of cheese on it roll up as you would a spring roll , dampen end corner with a little water to seal halfway through rolling , tuck in sides , & finish rolling heat oil , fry in batches til golden serve with desired sauce

name: Super easy cheesy enchiladas
ingredients: corn tortillas|cheese|shortening|red enchilada sauce|green chilies|onion|chicken
steps: preheat oven to 325-350 degrees heat the 3 t fat ingredient in a medium hot skillet dip each tortilla into the fat to soften leave each tortilla in the fat for only a second or two too long will cause the tortillas to rip drain on paper towels lightly grease a 13x9 baking dish pour a very scant amount of the enchilada sauce on the bottom just to coat fill each tortilla with the cheese fold over with fold side down and place in the dish reserve some of the cheese to top the enchiladas after all enchiladas have been filled , pour remaining sauce over them sprinkle with reserved cheese and bake until sauce is bubbly if using optional ingredients , mix all with cheese in a bowl fill the tortillas with the mix and proceed with the other steps

name: Super easy cheesy garlic bread
ingredients: refrigerated buttermilk biscuits|cheddar cheese|garlic|butter|nonstick cooking spray
steps: spray a bread pan with cooking spray put biscuits from one can on the bottom of the pan press together with clean fingers combine garlic / garlic salt and melted butter drizzle half the butter mixture over the biscuit layer sprinkle with half the cheese repeat with other can of biscuits and other half of butter mixture and cheese bake at 400 degrees farenheit for 30 minutes or until tested done by inserting a toothpick if the toothpick comes out clean , it's done cool in pan for 5 minutes out of the oven remove from pan and slice

name: Super easy cherry dump cake
ingredients: cherry pie filling|yellow cake mix|nuts|margarine
steps: dump all ingredients in order into a 9 x 13 glass dish place the margarine slices over the top of the nuts and bake 350 degrees in a preheated over for 30 to 45 minutes

name: Super easy chicken
ingredients: dried italian salad dressing mix|fat-free chicken broth|chicken breast halves
steps: place chicken in slow cooker mix broth and seasoning mix pour over chicken cook on high for 3 or 4 hours or until chicken is done

name: Super easy chicken broccoli pie
ingredients: cooked chicken breasts|frozen chopped broccoli|sharp cheddar cheese|eggs|bisquick|milk|dried onion flakes|salt|pepper
steps: preheat oven to 400 degrees in a greased pie plate , mix chicken , broccoli , 2 cups of cheddar , and onion flakes in a separate bowl , whisk together eggs , bisquick , milk , salt , and pepper pour egg mixture over chicken mixture bake 30-40 minutes or until an inserted knife comes out clean sprinkle remaining cheese over the top and bake a few more minutes until it melts let cool slightly before cutting

name: Super easy chicken cheese wraps
ingredients: cooked rice|salsa|black beans|mexicorn whole kernel corn|cooked chicken|cheddar cheese|flour tortillas|sour cream
steps: stir together all ingredients except tortillas in large bowl place about 1 cup filling in center of each warmed tortilla fold two opposite edges of tortilla toward center over filling roll up open end of tortilla toward opposite edge place on microwave-safe plate , seam-side down microwave 2 tortillas on medium-high power , turning or rearranging after half the time , until heated through repeat with remaining tortillas serve with salsa and sour cream , if desired

name: Super easy chicken and dumplings
ingredients: chicken breasts|chicken broth|cream of chicken soup|dried rosemary|biscuits|mixed vegetables|onion
steps: mix chicken breast meat , chicken broth , and undiluted cream of chicken soup into a 3-quart sauce pan with lid add dried rosemary and veggies and stir heat over medium-high heat until boiling , stirring frequently add biscuit pieces to the boiling broth cover with lid and reduce heat to simmer for 20-22 minutes

name: Super easy chicken and noodles
ingredients: condensed cream of chicken soup|milk|parmesan cheese|pepper|noodles|cooked chicken
steps: combine soup , milk , parmesan cheese , and pepper in large pot add noodles and chicken and heat through

name: Super easy chicken casserole
ingredients: chicken flavor stuffing mix|olive oil|chicken|condensed cream of chicken soup|mixed vegetables|shredded cheddar cheese
steps: preheat oven to 350f prepare stuffing mix as directed on package and set aside warm oil in pan on medium heat add chicken and cook until no longer pink add soup and mixed vegetables cook until vegetables are no longer frozen spoon into 2-qt baking dish sprinkle cheese on top of mixture layer stuffing on top of cheese , making sure to make it an even layer bake 30 minute or until heated through

name: Super easy chicken casserole with stuffing
ingredients: chicken breasts|mozzarella cheese|cream of chicken soup|stove top stuffing mix|garlic
steps: place each piece of chicken in casserole lay a piece of cheese on top of each piece cover the chicken with soup add your favorite spices to soup prepare stuffing according to package directions place stuffing on top of casserole bake uncovered at 325f for 1 hour

name: Super easy chicken cordon bleu
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|deli ham|pepperoni|cheddar cheese|black pepper|onion powder|garlic salt with parsley|parmesan cheese
steps: pre heat oven to 350 pound chicken until about 1 / 4 inch and place on a baking sheet place 2 slices of ham on each chicken , pepperoni , and cheddar cheese , then roll chicken up and make sure the chicken is seam side down sprinkle chicken with pepper , garlic salt , onion powder , and lots of parmesan cheese bake for 15 mins then flip the chicken and sprinkle seasonings and parmesan cheese on the other side and bake for another 15 minutes

name: Super easy chicken curry
ingredients: butter|boneless skinless chicken breasts|diced onions|fresh carrot|frozen peas|chicken broth|heavy cream|flour|curry powder|chili powder|red pepper flakes|ginger|garlic powder|cinnamon|salt and pepper
steps: brown off chicken breast with butter , set aside once the chicken cools off , cut into bite-sized pieces cook the onion down until it is translucent , using the same pan you cooked the chicken inches add carrots and cook until softened add all of your spices and cook for another 3 minutes add flour and scrape the bottom of the pan , like you're making a rue for a gravy add the whole can of chicken broth , slowly return the chicken back into the pan stir and simmer for 15 minutes add frozen peas and cream and simmer for another 5 minutes or so , until peas are fully cooked serve with rice ! sometimes i even mix the rice in just before i eat im gonna mix it on my plate anyway ! :)

name: Super easy chicken enchiladas
ingredients: flour tortillas|boneless skinless chicken breasts|cream of chicken soup|sour cream|pace picante sauce|chili powder|monterey jack cheese|tomatoes|scallion|lettuce
steps: pre-heat oven to 350 degrees f in a medium bowl , stir together soup , sour cream , picante sauce and the chili powder in another bowl , mix together only 1 cup of the sauce mixture with the shredded chicken and 1 / 2 cup of the cheese warm tortillas in a damp paper towel for approx 10 seconds in the microwave lay tortillas out and divide the chicken mixture evenly among the tortillas , running the filling down the center of each , roll up and lay them in an 11x8 baking dish pour the remaining sauce mixture over the tops of enchiladas , and sprinkle with the other 1 / 2 cup of cheese cover with foil and bake for 30 - 35 minutes , remove foil and bake an additional 5 minutes remove from oven , sprinkle chopped tomatoes and scallion over the top of dish serve with additional picante sauce and sour cream at the table enjoy !

name: Super easy chicken in a blanket
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|light cream cheese|portabella mushroom|refrigerated reduced-fat crescent rolls|italian seasoning
steps: preheat oven to 350 cut chicken breasts in half spread a layer of cream cheese on the chicken breast , then sprinkle the seasoning on top cover with mushrooms leave croissants in a rectangle and press together so it wont separate roll it over the top of the chicken and wrap under as far as possible bake on a cookie sheet until golden brown and chicken is done through

name: Super easy chicken manicotti
ingredients: garlic salt|chicken breast tenders|manicotti|sliced ripe olives|spaghetti sauce|mozzarella cheese
steps: spread about 1 / 3 of the spaghetti sauce in ungreased rectangular baking dish , 13x9x2 inches sprinkle garlic salt on chicken insert chicken into uncooked manicotti shells , stuffing from each end of shell to fill if necessary place shells on spaghetti sauce in dish pour remaining spaghetti sauce evenly over shells , covering completely sprinkle with olives and cheese stop here to store in refrigerator: cover unbaked manicotti tightly with aluminum foil and refrigerate no longer than 24 hours to store in freezer: wrap unbaked manicotti tightly with aluminum foil and label freeze no longer than 1 month to cook from refrigerator: about 1 hour before serving , heat oven to 350 degrees bake in covered baking dish about 1 hour , or until shells are tender to cook from freezer: about 1 1 / 2 hours before serving , heat oven to 350 degrees bake in covered baking dish about 1 1 / 2 hours or until shells are tender

name: Super easy chicken parmesan
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|whole canned tomatoes|herb with garlic soup mix|butter|mozzarella cheese|parmesan cheese|water
steps: in 13x9 casserole or baking dish , spread out chicken breasts and arrange tomatoes around them use edge of spoon to break tomatoes up into smaller chunks in medium sized bowl , mix together water , butter , and soup mix once mixed well , pour over chicken and tomatoes and bake for 25 minutes at 350f sprinkle mozzarella and parmesan cheese over chicken and bake for an additional 5 minutes or so , until cheese is melted enjoy !

name: Super easy chicken spaghetti
ingredients: white chicken meat|spaghetti|chicken broth|onion|rotel tomatoes|cream of mushroom soup|velveeta cheese
steps: mix chicken , onion , tomatoes , soup& cheese in large oven proof bowl microwave on high until cheese is melted , stirring every 30 seconds mix with cooked spaghetti spray two 9x13 pans with pam pour spaghetti mixture into pans bake at 375 degrees for 45-60 minutes this freezes well and may be frozen before baking

name: Super easy chickpea salad
ingredients: chickpeas|cucumber|red pepper|red onion|carrot|garlic|tomatoes|fresh basil leaves|parmesan cheese|fresh lemon juice|black pepper|balsamic vinaigrette|ranch dressing
steps: combine all ingredients in a large bowl chill at least 2 hours serve

name: Super easy chinese steak
ingredients: celery|carrot|bell pepper|flour|tomato sauce|water|soy sauce|canola oil|round steak|salt and pepper
steps: sear meat with salt and pepper in oil once meat is cooked , add flour and mix mixture will look pasty add all remaining ingredients bring to boil reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes , stirring occasionally be careful not to let stick serve over cooked white rice with green peas as side

name: Super easy chinese style stir fried mushrooms
ingredients: peanut oil|ginger|garlic|fresh shiitake mushrooms|soy sauce|green onion|sesame oil|toasted sesame seeds
steps: heat oil in a large skillet or stir-fry pan add ginger , and garlic cook , stirring constantly , just until fragrant toss in sliced mushrooms and cook several minutes or until mushrooms soften and start to brown drizzle in the soy sauce and seasme oil , stirring until most of liquid evaporates off remove from heat and garnish with sliced green onions and toasted sesame seeds

name: Super easy chinese sweet n sour ribs
ingredients: pork ribs|rice wine|vinegar|sugar|soy sauce|water
steps: boil about 1 l of water in a pot , or enough to cover the ribs carefully drop the ribs in the boiling water , stir til outside browns , roughly 1 minute drain ribs , put in a medium sized pot big enough for the ribs to be layed down in one layer a deeper pan will work too add rice wine , vinegar , sugar , soy sauce and water in the pot bring to a boil for about 10 minutes then reduce to a simmer cook uncovered , stirring occasionally , until the sauce is very dark and almost dry or to your desired thickness , roughly half an hour be careful not to dry all the sauce out , the sauce will reduce much quicker in the final stage , so keep an eye on it serve with steamed rice and stir fried veggies for a great chinese meal !

name: Super easy chocolate bar cookies
ingredients: butter|sugar|salt|all-purpose flour|sweetened condensed milk|semi-sweet chocolate chips|pecans|vanilla
steps: preheat oven 350 crust: beat butter in mixing bowl 30 seconds add sugar and salt , beat until combined scraping sides of bowl occasionally beat in flour , low speed until combined press 2 / 3 of mixture into an ungreased 9 x 13 pan filling: combine sweetened condensed milk and chocolate in medium sauce pan , stir over low heat until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth remove from heat stir in nuts and vanilla spread hot mixture over crust sprinkle remaining crust mixture over chocolate mixture bake 35 minutes or until golden cool in pan on rack , cut into bars

name: Super easy chocolate bars
ingredients: butter|granulated sugar|salt|all-purpose flour|sweetened condensed milk|semisweet chocolate piece|walnuts|vanilla
steps: preheat oven to 350 for crust , in large bowl , beat butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds add sugar and salt beat until combined add flour beat on low speed until combined press two-thirds of the crust mixture into the bottom of an ungreased 13x9x2-inch baking pan for filling , in medium saucepan , combine sweetened condensed milk and chocolate chips cook and stir over low heat until chocolate is melted remove from heat stir in nuts and vanilla spread filling over unbaked crust sprinkle with remaining crust mixture bake for 30-35 minutes or until golden cool in pan on wire rack cut into bars for softer bars , refrigerate the baked block for a short time before cutting

name: Super easy chocolate chip brownies
ingredients: semisweet chocolate morsels|graham cracker squares|sweetened condensed milk|confectioners' sugar
steps: preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit in a mixing bowl , combine the chocolate morsels , crushed graham crackers , and sweetened condensed milk grease an 8-inch by 8-inch pan , line with waxed paper , then grease the waxed paper press mixture into prepared pan bake for 30 minutes allow to cool slightly , yet turn out of pan while still warm and peel away waxed paper cut into squares , and roll in confectioners sugar

name: Super easy chocolate chip muffins
ingredients: flour|sugar|butter|lemon juice|milk|egg|baking soda|mini chocolate chip
steps: preheat oven to 350f combine milk and lemon juice in a bowl , set aside in a medium microwaveable bowl combine flour , sugar , and butter microwave on high for 30 seconds with a fork crumble set aside 1 / 2 cup of mixture beat an egg into milk add baking soda , let froth add to flour mixture add chocolate chips stir until just combined - do not overmix divide evenly in paper lined muffin pan sprinkle with set aside streusel bake 20 minutes

name: Super easy chocolate chip squares
ingredients: yellow cake mix|brown sugar|oil|water|eggs|vanilla extract|chocolate chips
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees in a large mixing bowl , combine yellow cake mix , brown sugar , oil , water , eggs , and vanilla extract mix until smooth stir in chocolate chips spread into a greased 9x13 inch pan bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes cool and cut into small squares

name: Super easy chocolate covered cherries
ingredients: confectioners' sugar|butter|milk|almond extract|maraschino cherries|semi-sweet chocolate chips|shortening
steps: in a small bowl combine confectioners sugar , softened butter , milk and extract kneed until you form a pliable "gooey dough" roll into 3 / 4"-1" balls , then smash flat to make a 2" circle line a baking sheet with wax paper important: be sure that each cherry is completely patted dry place 1 cherry in the center of each circle carefully enclose the cherry with the circle of "gooey dough" , and place them stem side up on the baking pan loosely cover and refrigerate overnight place chocolate chips and shortening into a microwave safe bowl heat for 30 seconds , stir , heat 30 seconds , stir , etc -- until melted and stir again let sit 1 minute hold the cherries by the stem and dip into chocolate , covering every bit of cherry allow excess chocolate to drain off and return each to the wax paper lined baking sheet refrigerate baking sheet immediately just until chocolate has hardened , then transfer to room temp sealed container best served after one week for juiciest cherries keeps up to 6 weeks in a sealed container enjoy !

name: Super easy chocolate mousse
ingredients: eggs|sugar|heavy cream|instant coffee|dark chocolate
steps: melt chocolate and set aside in a blender combine egg yolks and sugar , mix for 2 minutes add chocolate and heavy cream and coffee , blend for 2 minutes add egg whites and blend for 4 minutes pour into serving dish and refrigerate for at least 3 hours

name: Super easy chocolate nut fudge
ingredients: butter|milk chocolate frosting|milk chocolate chips|miniature marshmallow|vanilla extract|pecans
steps: line an 8 inch square baking dish with foil spread foil with butter in a medium saucepan combine chocolate chips , marshmallows , and frosting cook and stir over medium low heat until marshmallows and chips are melted remove from heat and stir in vanilla and pecans pour into prepared pan refrigerate about 2 hours using foil , lift fudge out of pan discard foil cut fudge into 1 inch squares store in the refrigerator makes about 2 lbs

name: Super easy chocolate pancakes or waffles
ingredients: complete pancake and waffle mix|unsweetened cocoa|granulated sugar|water|walnuts|semi-sweet chocolate chips
steps: combine pancake mix , cocoa and sugar in large bowl stir in water with wire whisk until large lumps disappear add walnuts and chocolate chips , stir until evenly mixed let batter rest for five minutes cook according to package directions

name: Super easy chocolate peanut butter bars
ingredients: powdered sugar|peanut butter|butter|graham cracker crumbs|chocolate chips
steps: preheat oven to 250 degrees f combine sugar , peanut butter , butter , and crumbs in an electric mixer mix until well combined press mixture into a 9 by 13 inch pan cover with chocolate chips bake for 5 minutes , or until chocolate is melted

name: Super easy chocolate pie
ingredients: graham cracker crust|milk chocolate candy bars|cool whip
steps: thaw cool whip and put in medium size bowl melt candy bars in microwave safe bowl until creamy using wire whisk , stir melted candy bars into cool whip pour this into graham cracker crust chill for about 30 minutes you may want to add more candy bars to suit your taste

name: Super easy chocolate ricotta mousse
ingredients: ricotta cheese|confectioners' sugar|semisweet chocolate|chocolate shavings
steps: use a food processor or imersion blender to blend the ricotta , confectioners' sugar , and melted chocolate together until you reach a smooth consistency top with shaved chocolate or eat as it

name: Super easy chocolate truffles
ingredients: semisweet chocolate|cream cheese|powdered sugar|vanilla extract|extract|cocoa|nuts
steps: melt chocolate in the microwave on high for 60 seconds stir and continue to cook on high for another 30 seconds or until chocolate is completely melted beat cream cheese until smooth add powdered sugar and continue beating until well blended stir in chocolate , vanilla and extract flavouring refrigerate for 2 hours or until firm shape into 1 inch balls roll into cocoa , powdered sugar , nuts or dip into melted chocolate store in refrigerator alternative use white chocolate in place of semi-sweet chips and follow same directions

name: Super easy chocolatey chip cookies
ingredients: white cake mix|water|milk chocolate chips|white chocolate chips
steps: preheat oven to 325 degrees f mix all ingredients together in a medium bowl grease cookie sheets and drop"cookie" batter by tbls onto sheets bake for 12-15 minutes or until edges are golden brown cool on a wire rack

name: Super easy cinnamon rolls
ingredients: french bread dough|butter|brown sugar|cinnamon|powdered sugar|milk|vanilla
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees unroll bread dough spead softened butter over bread dough mix the sugar and cinnamon together in a bowl sprinkle the cinnamon / sugar mixture over the buttered bread dough starting at the small end of the bread dough , roll tightly and seal the seam cut into 8 equal pieces by cutting the roll in half , then each half in half , then each quater in half place all 8 pieces cut side down so that the sides are touching and there is one in the middle in a greased 9" pie pan bake for 20-25 minutes or until cinnamon rolls are nicely browned stir together the powdered sugar , softened butter , milk and vanilla and spread over warm cinnamon rolls

name: Super easy clam chowder
ingredients: condensed cream of celery soup|condensed cream of potato soup|new england clam chowder|minced clams|half-and-half cream|heavy whipping cream
steps: mix cream of celery soup , cream of potato soup , clam chowder , 1 can undrained clams , 1 can drained clams , half-and-half cream , and whipping cream into a slow cooker cover , and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours

name: Super easy cocktail sauce
ingredients: ketchup|chili sauce|prepared horseradish|worcestershire sauce
steps: in a small bowl , combine all ingredients mix well

name: Super easy coconut cream pie
ingredients: pie crusts|vanilla instant pudding mix|milk|flaked coconut|cool whip
steps: in a large bowl mix pudding and milk until pudding becomes thick fold in 4 oz of the cool-whip fold in 1 cup of coconut spread mix into bottom of pie crust spread remaining cool-whip on top sprinkle with left-over coconut serve cooled keep refrigerated enjoy !

name: Super easy corn crusted baked salmon
ingredients: cornmeal|salt|black pepper|dried italian seasoning|caesar salad dressing|lemon juice|salmon fillets
steps: stir together cornmeal and seasonings in a shallow dish in separate shallow dish , combine dressing and lemon juice dip each salmon fillet in caesar mixture , then dip in cornmeal mixture to coat well on both sides place on a baking sheet in single layer bake at 450 f for 6 to 8 minutes or until fillets flake easily with a fork depending on your oven , you may need more or less time

name: Super easy cranberry sugar cookies
ingredients: cranberry muffin mix|butter|sugar
steps: heat oven to 350 degrees in large bowl , combine quick bread mix and butter mix well shape dough into 1-inch balls place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets flatten balls to 1 / 8-inch thickness with bottom of glass dipped in sugar bake at 350 degrees for nine to 11 minutes or until golden brown watch carefully as these burn easily due to the amount of butter cool 2 minutes remove from cookie sheets and continue cooling on wire rack

name: Super easy crescent pecan pie bars
ingredients: refrigerated crescent dinner roll|pecans|light corn syrup|sugar|vanilla|egg
steps: preheat oven to 350f unroll crescent rolls into bottom of 9x13 , 9x11 , or 9x12 inch ungreased baking pan spread the dough over the bottom of the pan , and up the sides 1 / 2 inch use a drop or two of water to help seal the perforations in the dough bake in 350 oven for 8-9 minutes it won't be cooked through meanwhile , mix together all other ingredients pour / spread pecan mixture over partially baked dough bake for another 20-22 minutes let cool for at least 1 hour , then cut into bars

name: Super easy crock pot french dip sandwiches
ingredients: rump roast|condensed beef broth|condensed french onion soup|french rolls|butter
steps: trim excess fat from the meat and place the meat in a crockpot add the beef broth and the french onion soup cook on high or low until the meat is tender remove the meat and shred it with 2 forks to serve , split open the rolls and butter them add some of the shredded meat pour some of the broth into a ramekin and dip the sandwich into the broth before each bite

name: Super easy crock pot kielbasa
ingredients: kielbasa|spicy mustard|apricot preserves
steps: slice kielbasa into 1 / 4" rounds add kielbasa to crock pot with mustard and preserves , stir cover and cook on low for 4-6 hours set out the toothpicks and watch it go !

name: Super easy crock pot plum roast
ingredients: beef|plum jam|onion soup mix
steps: place the meat into the crock pot mix the jam with the soup mix pour over the roast cook on high for 6 hours , or on low for 10 hours let the roast rest for a few minutes before slicing if you are really patient , chill overnight , then you can cut sheer slices reheat gently

name: Super easy crock pot taco soup
ingredients: ground beef|onion|mexican-style tomatoes|kidney beans|kernel corn|tomato sauce|taco seasoning|water
steps: brown beef and onions in skillet drain combine all ingredients in crockpot cook on low for 4-6 hours ladle into bowls serve with grated cheese , sour cream , chips and avacado

name: Super easy crock pot turkey breast
ingredients: turkey breast|onion soup mix
steps: rinse and dry turkey breast lift skin up from meat , do not remove cover whole breast with mix inside and out , including under the skin cook on high 1 hour and low 6 to 7 hours or until meat registers 160 if using smaller turkey breast adjust time accordingly

name: Super easy cucumber salad
ingredients: cucumbers|white sugar|white vinegar|salt|pepper|celery seed
steps: put the peeled sliced cucumbers into a large resealable container that fits in your refrigerator in a separate bowl mix the sugar , vinegar , and spices pour the marinade over the cucumbers chill , let sit for about 30 minutes before serving i don't suggest putting new cucumbers into old marinade , too much risk of contamination make a fresh batch of marinade for each fresh batch of cucumbers

name: Super easy curry spread
ingredients: mayonnaise|curry powder|worcestershire sauce|salt
steps: combine all of the ingredients and mix well let the spread sit in the refridgerator for two hours before serving to let the flavors develop

name: Super easy dark chocolate fudge
ingredients: nestle semi-sweet chocolate chips|sweetened condensed milk|walnuts|vanilla extract
steps: over low heat , melt the chips in the sweetened condensed milk remove from the heat and stir in the nuts and vanilla spread evenly into an wax paper lined 8x8 pan chill and pop out of pan peel off wax paper and cut into 1-inch squares

name: Super easy donuts basic recipe
ingredients: frozen white bread dough|canola oil|strawberry frosting|colored sprinkles|seedless raspberry preserves|superfine sugar|confectioners' sugar|prepared vanilla pudding|chocolate frosting
steps: basic donuts: line jellyroll pan with foil coat with cooking spray on lightly floured surface , roll dough out to 14" x 6" rectangle using 2 3 / 4" round biscuit cutter , cut out 12 donuts arrange on foil , 2" apart cover lightly with damp paper towels let rise in warmplace untildoubled in size , about 2 hours in a large pot , heat 2" of oil over medium heat until 300f on deep-frying thermometer add donuts in batches and cook , turning once , until golden and cooked through , about 5-7 minutes drain on rack strawberry-frosted donuts: prepare basic donuts recipe , using 3"round donut cutter in place of biscuit cutter cook as directed if desired , for donut holes , cook center cut outs for 5 minutes place strawberry frosting in microwave safe bowl and cook on high for about 30 seconds to soften spoon some frosting over each donut decorate with sprinkles and let stand for 15 minutes to set simple jelly donuts: prepare and cook basic donuts as directed once cool , make a 1 5" deep cut into the side of each donut with a paring knife place 1 cup of preserves into a plastic food storage bag cut 1 / 4" off 1 corner insert corner of bag into cut in each donut squeeze 11 / 2 tbsp preserves into each in a bowl , mix superfine sugar and confectioners' sugar adding 2 donuts at a time , toss to coat boston cream donuts: prepare and cook basic donuts as directed with a paring knife , make a 1 5" deep cut into the side of each donut place 3packages vanilla pudding into alarge plastic food storage bag cut 1 / 4" off one corner insert the corner of the bag in each donut squeeze about 2 tbsp pudding into each place chocolate frosting in a microwave-safe bowl microwave on high to soften , about 30 seconds spoon some frosting over each donut let stand about 15 minutes to set enjoy ! :)

name: Super easy egg flower soup
ingredients: chicken stock|egg|salt|pepper
steps: bring stock to a boil then simmer slowly stir in beaten egg until soup thickens add salt pepper according to taste serve hot

name: Super easy egg rolls
ingredients: egg roll wrap|cooked pork|canned shrimp|water chestnuts|celery ribs|radishes|scallions|cabbage|carrots|bean sprouts|ginger|garlic powder|salt|cumin|tarragon|black pepper|olive oil
steps: with a small food processor shred the pork , celery , radishes , and scallions together put in big bowl rinse the water chestnuts and shrimp in cold water before using then shred the water chestnuts and shrimp put with pork mix then the shred the cabbage and carrots together to make 2 cups of mix put in with the pork mix shred the bean sprouts on a quick pulse and add to mix add all your spices and stir and taste if you think it needs something more lay egg roll wrapper flat and put on a loose 1 / 3 cup of filling in center and arrange it in a small log , fold sides over and start to roll place on greased cookie sheeat sides not touching brush tops of egg rolls lightly with oil and bake bake at 375 degree oven for 30 minutes

name: Super easy eggnog cheesecake
ingredients: pirouette cookies|graham cracker crumbs|margarine|cream cheese|eggnog|milk|instant vanilla pudding|rum|ground nutmeg|cool whip|semisweet chocolate
steps: trim pirouette cookies to 1 1 / 2 to 2 inch lengths set aside crush trimmed off ends into crumbs combine cookie and graham cracker crumbs with margarine press firmly into a 9-inch springform pan beat cream cheese with an electric mixer until smooth gradually add eggnog , milk , pudding mix , rum and nutmeg , beating continuously until very smooth pour over graham cracker / cookie crust chill for at least 3 hours remove from fridge run a hot knife or metal spatula around the edges of pan to loosen remove sides of pan gently press reserved cookies onto the side of cake , cut sides down garnish as desired with cool whip and grated chocolate serve !

name: Super easy eggplant parmesan
ingredients: eggplant|pasta sauce|mozzarella cheese
steps: preheat oven to 350f peel eggplant and slice thin layer eggplant and other ingredients if desired cover with foil and back 45 minutes take the foil off for the last 5 minutes of baking enjoy !

name: Super easy flavored oil for bread
ingredients: italian seasoning|salt|olive oil
steps: combine all ingredients use as dip for bread , specifically italian or french bread , but very good on any others , too

name: Super easy fresh corn salad
ingredients: sweet corn|red onion|apple cider vinegar|extra virgin olive oil|salt|fresh ground black pepper|fresh basil leaf
steps: cook the ears of corn for about 5-7 minutes in a large pot of boiling salted water drain and place into a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking when corn is cooled , cut kernels off of the cob mix corn in a large bowl with red onions , oil , vinegar , salt and pepper toss in fresh basil ribbons right before serving i usually taste to see if more salt and pepper is needed can be served cold or at room temperature

name: Super easy fruit cobbler
ingredients: butter|sugar|flour|baking powder|milk|fruit
steps: melt butter in the bottom of a pan mix sugar , flour , baing powder & milk together pour this mixture over the butter do not stir ! add the fruit on top of that mixture do not stir ! bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour

name: Super easy fruit cocktail cobbler cake
ingredients: fruit cocktail|yellow cake mix|unsalted butter
steps: pre-heat oven to 350 degrees melt one stick of butter in a microwave safe dish for 1 minute 40 seconds on 50% power pour entire contents of fruit cocktail cans into a 8 x 11 glass pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray spread fruit cocktail evenly on bottom of pan sprinkle box of yellow cake mix , evenly , over top of fruit cocktail do not mix cake mix and fruit cocktail use the back of a spoon to smooth out cake mix drizzle melted butter over top of cake mix bake on 350 degrees for 45 minutes

name: Super easy fruit dip
ingredients: marshmallow cream|lemon yogurt|cool whip lite
steps: mix all ingrediant together until well blended , cover place in refridgerator for at least 4 hours mix again before serving perfect with your favorite fruit or right out of the bowl if you can't find lemon yogurt you can use plain yogurt and 2 tablesoons of lemon juice:

name: Super easy fruit salad
ingredients: frozen sweetened strawberries|peaches|pineapple|red seedless grapes|banana
steps: peel bananas and slice all fruit to desired size do not strain strawberries mix all ingredients in a bowl other suggested fruit to try include mandarin oranges , cherries , cantaloupe , and raisins kiwis would probably be good in it too

name: Super easy fudgy mini chocolate cakes
ingredients: semisweet baking chocolate|butter|eggs|sugar|salt|flour
steps: set oven to 350 degrees in the microwave or a small saucepan , melt the chocolate with butter , stirring until smooth in a bowl , whisk together egg , sugar and salt until yellow and light whisk in the melted chocolate batter to combine add in the flour until thoroughly combined grease or butter 8 cupcake tins evenly divide the batter between each tin at this point you can refrigerate and bake later bake for about 12 minutes , just until the tops crack remove the cakes from the oven with a tea towel or oven mitts , place foil on top of the cupcake tins and seal on all sides turn over onto a flat surface and bang the bottom of the cupcake tins remove the cupcake tins to leave the cakes upside-down on the foil carefully turn right-side up and place on a plate serve immediately

name: Super easy garlic chicken
ingredients: garlic|olive oil|breadcrumbs|parmesan cheese|boneless skinless chicken breast halves
steps: preheat oven to 425'f warm the garlic and olive oil in the oven for a few minutes just to blend the flavors in the meantime mix together the breadcrumbs and parmesan cheese dip the chicken breasts in the olive oil / garlic mixture , then into the breadcrumb mixture place in a shallow baking dish bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes until no longer pink and the juices run clear

name: Super easy general tso chicken dinner
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breast|stir fry vegetables|stir-fry sauce|olive oil|cooked rice
steps: cube chicken and brown in oil in a large skillet after chicken is done , add vegetables and stir-fry until crisp tender pour in sauce and simmer until heated through serve over rice

name: Super easy gluten roast
ingredients: vital wheat gluten|lipton onion soup mix|black pepper|sugar|cayenne|soy sauce|olive oil|worcestershire sauce|water|vegetarian beef broth
steps: place roast ingredients in a bread machine on dough setting or in stand mixer with dough hooks mix on high for 15 minutes you may need to scrape down occasionally in mixer set aside for 5-10 minutes prepare broth do not make it hot ! if using bouillon cubes , crush them and just add to your water , it will mix as it cooks form roast into oval place in slow cooker , add broth set on low , for 8 hours turn halfway through when done , remove and drain on paper towels serve immediately or place in sealed container or ziploc baggy with some leftover broth

name: Super easy gooey pecan caramel rolls
ingredients: pecans|brown sugar|heavy whipping cream|refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees in a buttered 9x13 baking dish , sprinkle the pecans sprinkle brown sugar evenly over the pecans pour whipping cream over the brown sugar cut each of the biscuits into quarters place each biscuit quarter into the pan on top of the brown sugar / cream mixture and press down lightly bake 20 to 30 minutes or until the biscuits are golden brown remove from oven and immediately turn onto a large serving plate or platter and serve

name: Super easy gooey slime
ingredients: cornstarch|water
steps: stir all together in a pan or large bowl add more cornstarch or water if needed add food coloring for color before each time playing add water

name: Super easy graham cracker sandwiches
ingredients: graham crackers|chocolate fudge frosting mix
steps: i recommend using jiffy brand frosting mix for the consistancy to be correct make frosting according to box directions break graham crackers in half cross way to make each into 2 squares spread frosting on one square & top with the other square repeat this couldn't be easier - these will be eaten in no time especially good once the graham crackers soften a bit & the frosting firms up a bit

name: Super easy green tea smoothie
ingredients: green tea bag|boiling water|mashed banana|ice|orange juice concentrate|fresh ginger|honey
steps: brew green tea in water steep to desired strength , and discard tea bag refridgerate 30 minutes , or until cool puree tea , banana , ice , orange juice concentrate , and ginger in blender until smooth add sweetener drink immediately , or place in freezer for up to two hours , or until ready to serve

name: Super easy ham and swiss pie
ingredients: smoked ham|swiss cheese|green onion|bisquick baking mix|milk|salt|pepper|eggs|tomatoes|green bell pepper
steps: heat oven to 400 degrees grease a 9 inche pie plate sprinkle ham , cheese and green onions in the pie plate stir bisquick mix , milk , salt , pepper and the eggs until blended pour in pie plate bake 35-40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean cool 5 minutes garnish with tomato slices and bell pepper rings

name: Super easy hash browns potato soup
ingredients: onion|butter|chicken broth|frozen hash browns|cream of celery soup|cream of chicken soup|milk|velveeta cheese|bacon bits
steps: saute onion in butter or oil until transparent add broth , bring to boil add hash browns , bring to boil add soups and milk , bring to boil add cheese and heat until cheese melts optional , serve with bacon bits on top

name: Super easy honey curry chicken
ingredients: chicken thighs|butter|honey|mustard|salt|curry powder
steps: dip chicken in sauce place in casserole dish skin side up bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour , basteing every 15 minutes

name: Super easy honey garlic spareribs
ingredients: pork side ribs|garlic powder|barbecue sauce
steps: preheat oven to 350f place two 18" pieces of tinfoil shiny side together fold 1 / 4" over along the entire length of one side then fold again open the tinfoil to make one large sheet and place on a large cookie sheet or baking pan place the ribs in a single layer on the foil and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon garlic powder flip and sprinkle with a second teaspoon of garlic powder close the tinfoil over the ribs and double fold to seal close both ends and double fold bake for one hour remove the ribs from the foil and cut into individual ribs place in a large casserole dish and cover with the sparerib sauce place the lid on the casserole or cover with tinfoil bake for 70-80 minutes or until very tender before serving , stir to coat with sauce

name: Super easy honey mustard sauce or salad dressing
ingredients: mayonnaise|yellow mustard|honey|mustard powder|salt
steps: wisk together all ingredients refrigerate before serving store in refrigerator

name: Super easy horchata
ingredients: vanilla-flavored rice milk|almond meal|ground cinnamon|raw sugar
steps: blend all together in blender till frothy serve over ice if desired

name: Super easy ice cream
ingredients: heavy whipping cream|sugar|vanilla extract|egg yolks
steps: bring 2 cups heavy whipping cream to a gentle boil stir in 1 / 3 cup of sugar until disolved remove from heat in a seperate bowl , wisk egg yokes until blended slowly pour cream mixture into egg yokes and wisk until blended allow mixture to cool to room temperature when the mixture has cooled , transfer to a freezer safe container and freeze

name: Super easy impossible coconut custard pie
ingredients: eggs|milk|flaked coconut|butter|sugar|biscuit mix
steps: preheat oven to 350f blend all ingredients in blender or food processor grease and flour a 10-inch pie plate pour mixture in pan and bake for 45 minutes or until custard is set chill well before serving

name: Super easy italian chicken
ingredients: balsamic vinegar|boneless skinless chicken breast halves|extra virgin olive oil|red potatoes|white onion|mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning|white wine|fresh green beans|fresh carrot|crushed tomatoes|fresh basil|fresh oregano|italian cheese
steps: cut chicken into 1" slices place in a bowl and douse with balsamic vinegar , set aside chop all your ingredients in a deep skillet , heat 1 tbls olive oil over medium-high heat brown chicken and remove from pan add remaining 1 tbls olive oil to same skillet add a thin layer of potatoes and onion , sprinkle with monteray seasoning , and repeat until all your potatoes and onions are in the pan let cook , stirring occasionally until potatoes and onion begin to brown add green beans and carrots , sprinkle with a touch more montreal seasoning add chicken back to the pan pour crushed tomatoes over the top sprinkle with basil and oregano cover and cook over medium heat until potatoes are tender meanwhile: turn on broiler when potatoes are tender , sprinkle cheese over the top , and place under broiler just until the cheese melts and begins to turn brown

name: Super easy italian parker house rolls
ingredients: italian salad dressing|refrigerated buttermilk biscuits|parmesan cheese|poppy seed
steps: heat oven to 400 pour dressing in small bowl seperate biscuits and coat each one with dressing fold biscuit in half place 2 biscuits , seam side down into each lightly greased muffin pans combine parmesan cheese and poppy seeds , and sprinkle on top of each biscuit bake 10-12 minutes till golden brown

name: Super easy jelly doughnuts
ingredients: refrigerated buttermilk biscuits|jelly|egg|oil
steps: heat oil flatten biscuits place spoonful of jelly on to 10 flattened biscuits brush egg whites around the outside of jellied biscuits place the rest of the flattened biscuits on top and press around the edges to secure fry in hot oil until golden brown drain on paper towel enjoy !

name: Super easy kulfi pakistani ice cream
ingredients: half-and-half|cool whip|sweetened condensed milk|pistachios|rose water|bread
steps: blend all in blender freeze in pop sicle makers

name: Super easy layered crab dip
ingredients: cream cheese|onion|worcestershire sauce|lemon juice|chili|crabmeat|parsley
steps: mix cheese , onion , worcestershire sauce and lemon juice together spread in a shallow serving dish spread chili sauce over top drain and rinse crab and spread over chili sauce sprinke with parsley serve with assorted crackers

name: Super easy lazy stuffed cabbage casserole
ingredients: ground sirloin|instant rice|onion|head of cabbage|campbell's condensed tomato soup|water|diced tomatoes|salt|pepper|garlic powder
steps: preheat oven to 350 spray 13 x 9 pan with pam mix tomato soup , 1 / 2 soup can of water and diced tomatoes together in a bowl until blended place a layer of chopped cabbage on bottom of pan put 1 / 2 of chopped onions over cabbage crumble 1 / 2 of raw ground sirloin over onions and cabbage season with salt , pepper and garlic powder sprinkle 1 / 2 of uncooked rice over this layer pour 1 / 2 of tomato mixture over this layer repeat layers , ending with rice and tomato mixture on top cover with foil bake for 1 hour covered , uncover and bake until liquid is reduced to your personal taste we like ours with some juice served with fresh baked bread and butter , great comfort food on a cold night

name: Super easy lemon cookies
ingredients: lemon cake mix|eggs|vegetable oil|lemon rind|pecan halves
steps: preheat oven to 350 combine all ingredients and stir until combined drop onto ungreased cookie sheet by rounded teaspoons about 2 inches a part press a pecan half into the center of each bake 9-11 minute or until edges are golden cool for 1 minute before removing to a wire rack store airtight

name: Super easy lemon mousse
ingredients: lemon pie filling|heavy whipping cream|vanilla
steps: dump pie filling into a large bowl pour 3 cups of whipping cream and 1 teaspoon of vanilla into the bowl whip with electric mixer until fluffy put in serving bowls and refrigerate for at least 3 hours-- the colder the mousse is , the better

name: Super easy lemon pie
ingredients: reduced fat graham cracker crust|lemon yogurt|sugar-free lemon gelatin|cool whip free
steps: combine yogurt , dry gelatin and cool whip mixing well spoon into the pie crust freeze for several hours or overnight

name: Super easy lemonade pie
ingredients: graham cracker crust|pink lemonade|sweetened condensed milk|cool whip
steps: mix pink lemonade and sweetened condensed milk until well blended fold in cool whip pour in graham cracker crust chill until set

name: Super easy lentils
ingredients: red lentils|water|onion|bell pepper|carrot|tomato sauce|soy sauce|parsley flakes|bay leaf|garlic|dried basil
steps: mix all ingredients in a medium pot , bring to a boil and reduce to low-medium heat to simmer for 1 / 2 hour , stirring occasionally serve with whole grain - toast , rice , quinoa , rolls , etc freezable

name: Super easy lite banana pudding
ingredients: reduced-fat vanilla wafers|fat-free sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix|skim milk|cool whip free|bananas
steps: in whatever size dish you use put a single layer of vanilla wafers in bottom , and set aside in large bowl , mix pudding mix and milk according to directions on box let sit for 5 minutes till set fold cool whip into pudding slice bananas into 1 / 4 inch slices and layer over wafers spoon pudding mixture over bananas top as desired i usually lay a layer of vanilla wafers around outside of dish , but you can also crush some wafers and sprinkle over the top , or top with additional bananas and cool whip but if you use bananas for garnish , toss with lemon juice first to avoid browning

name: Super easy lo mein
ingredients: angel hair pasta|mixed vegetables|hoisin sauce|vegetable broth|soy sauce|cornstarch|ground ginger
steps: bring a large pot of water to a boil add angel hair pasta and mixed veggies to pot continue to cook for 5 minutes while the pasta is cooking , prepare the sauce combine the hoisin sauce , broth , soy sauce , cornstarch , and ginger in a small bowl when pasta is done , drain well transfer back into the pot , or into a serving dish combine with the sauce mixture serve and enjoy !

name: Super easy loaded potato soup
ingredients: red potatoes|yellow onion|green onion|garlic cloves|bacon|chicken stock|butter|sour cream|cream of chicken soup|colby-monterey jack cheese|heavy cream|salt|white pepper|black pepper|paprika|dried parsley
steps: peel and chop potatoes into cubes put potatoes into a large pot add 32 oz container of chicken stock add water until the potatoes are covered with liquid add the whole yellow onion and minced garlic clean the green onions removing the add the whole green onions to the pot cook the bacon in the microwave add the whole slices of bacon bring the pot of ingredients to a soft boil stirring occasionally once the potatoes are cooked , remove the yellow and green onions and bacon from the pot add one or two sticks of butter , 8 oz sour cream , cream of chicken soup and 1 cup heavy cream stir until blended add bag of shredded cheese stir until blended add salt , parsley , paprika , and peppers add more to taste serve with a little sour cream , shredded cheese , or crumbled bacon on top

name: Super easy macaroni salad
ingredients: macaroni|cheese|cubed ham|miracle whip|mustard
steps: cook , drain and rinse macaroni and put in fridge while you dice up cheese and ham mix together cold macaroni , cheese , and ham in a bowl in a separate bowl mix miracle whip and mustard mix it all together and chill or serve immediately

name: Super easy mahi mahi
ingredients: lime juice|salsa verde|mahi mahi fillets|blackening seasoning
steps: combine lime juice , salsa verde and mahi-mahi fillets in a freezer bag marinade for two to three hours , turning every thirty minutes or so place fillets on a greased cooking sheet if a little of the marinade still remains on the fish , it is okay dust with blackened seasoning to taste bake at 350f for 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork

name: Super easy make ahead appetizer fig compote and cheese
ingredients: fig compote|cheese
