steps: in a large skillet , brown the meats with the next 10 ingredients make sure the meat is browned really well add the rotel tomatoes , chicken broth , and wine bring to a boil reduce to simmer until most of the liquid is absorbed and meat becomes very tender i put a lid half on for awhile and then take it off towards the end to help reduce the remaining liquid garnish with fresh cilantro serve in crispy taco shells , or warmed flour tortillas we top our tacos with shredded lettuce , diced tomatoes , sour cream , chopped black olives , sliced pickled jalepenos , salsa , and cheddar cheese this is a pretty basic recipe and if i have any left over , i'll dump a cup of cooked rice in and make untraditional stuffed cabbage rolls or even stuffed poblano peppers it's a jumping off point so you can play around with it and the spices to tailor it to your preference

name: Taco filling oamc
ingredients: vegetable oil|onions|garlic cloves|jalapenos|chili powder|ground coriander|ground beef|crushed tomatoes|coarse salt
steps: heat oil in a large skillet over med high heat add onions and cook until softened , about 5 minutes add garlic , jalapenos and seasonings , cook , stirring 1 minute add beef cook , breaking up meat with a wooden spoon , until no longer pink , about 5 minutes , stirring occasionally until liquid has evaporated , 15 to 20 minutes i placed 3 cup servings in freezer zip loc bags (it will make 4 different meals -- tacos , burritos , taco salads and taco soup !

name: Taco filling crockette
ingredients: ground beef|onion|chili powder|dried oregano|paprika|salt|taco seasoning mix|worcestershire sauce|tomato sauce|taco shells|taco sauce|lettuce|cheddar cheese
steps: brown ground beef and drain well place in crockette add onion , chili powder , oregano , paprika , salt , taco seasoning mix , worcestershire sauce and tomato sauce cover cook 8 to 12 hours fill taco shells , top with sauce , lettuce and cheese

name: Taco filling ground beef
ingredients: ground beef|onion|oregano|cumin|garlic powder
steps: brown ground beef with onion drain add other ingredients simmer add more seasoning to taste this can be a little dry this is not health food ! i have added a little cooking oil to the mix add salt and pepper add ground beef to your favorite taco shells top with cheese , sour cream , lettuce , tomato , etc enjoy !

name: Taco flavored oven fried chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|buttermilk|breadcrumbs|flour|taco seasoning mix|salt|pepper
steps: put chicken breasts in large ziplock bag pour buttermilk over chicken in bag add one tablespoon of the taco seasoning to buttermilk / chicken marinate for at least 2 hours mix breadcrumbs , flour , remaining taco seasoning , salt and pepper pour some of crumbs on a pie plate lift buttermilk coated chicken breasts out of bag and roll in crumbs or , you could do the shake and bake method spray pan with cooking spray if you have a rack you can set on the pan , spray that set chicken pieces on rack on in pan you could also use a broiler pan optional: spray chicken pieces with butter flavored pam if you have some around bake chicken pieces at 375 for about 35 to 40 minutes

name: Taco foldovers
ingredients: refrigerated pie crusts|mayonnaise|salsa|cooked chicken|chopped tomato|green onion|cheddar cheese
steps: heat oven to 450f if using homemade pie crust , roll into 2 rounds place pie crusts on ungreased cookie sheet combine mayo and salsa spread mayo mixture evenly over each pie crust sprinkle half of each crust with remaining ingredients fold untopped half of each crust over filling do not seal bake at 450f for 14 to 18 minutes or until golden brown cut into wedges to serve if desired , top with shredded lettuce , sliced ripe olives , sour cream and additional salsa

name: Taco fries
ingredients: baking potatoes|taco seasoning mix
steps: heat oven to 450 lightly spray a cookie sheet place potatoes in a bag add taco mix and shake well to coat good place on sheet bake 20-30 minutes , turn them once , cook till desired crispness

name: Taco frito salad
ingredients: hamburger meat|taco seasoning|water|lettuce|cherry tomatoes|red onion|avocados|black beans|frozen corn|shredded cheddar cheese|catalina dressing|fritos corn chips
steps: brown hamburger meat in frying pan drain off fat and return to pan with taco seasoning and water simmer meat an additional 3-5 minutes until most of water is absorbed allow meat to cool for about 10 minutes in a separate bowl , mix lettuce , tomatoes , onion , avocados , beans , corn , cheese , and cooled taco meat mix as much dressing and fritos as you desire when you are ready to serve salad if you mix them in too early , the salad and fritos will be soggy

name: Taco grande
ingredients: flour tortillas|lean hamburger|taco seasoning mix|water|salsa|colby-monterey jack cheese|green onion|iceberg lettuce|sour cream
steps: preheat oven to 350f spray bottom and sides of deep dish baker with nonstick cooking spray arrange four tortillas in bottom of baker , overlapping slightly in large skillet , cook ground hamburger over medium heat 8-10 minutes or until no longer pink , breaking burger into small crumbles drain , if necessary add taco seasoning mix and water cook according to package directions remove from heat stir in 1 cup of the salsa spoon humburger mixture evenly over tortillas in baker sprinkle with 1 cup of the cheese sprinkle half of the green onion over cheese top with remaining four tortillas , overlapping slightly and pressing down lightly spread remaining salsa over tortillas sprinkle with remaining cheese and onion bake 28-30 minutes or until cheese is melted remove from oven let stand 5 minutes cut into wedges serve with lettuce and sour cream

name: Taco in a bag
ingredients: hamburger|southwest seasoning|lettuce|onions|tomatoes|cheese|pace picante sauce|taco chips
steps: brown the hamburger with the southwestern seasoning drain open the chips bags add into each bag: 2 tablespoons meat 2 tablespoons lettuce 2 tablespoons tomato 1 pinch onion 2 tablespoon salsa serve with a plastic spoon and cheer for the washington demons ! this recipe can easily be expanded from 6 to sixty

name: Taco in a bowl
ingredients: ground beef|stewed tomatoes|taco seasoning|water|pork and beans|corn chips|lettuce
steps: in a skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink drain add the tomatoes , taco seasoning and water mix well add pork and beans bring to a boil reduce heat cover and simmer for 15 minutes to serve , place corn chips in four soup bowls top with beef mixture and toppings of your choice

name: Taco in a pan
ingredients: lean ground beef|taco seasoning|potato|taco cheese|salsa|lettuce|chopped tomato|sour cream|guacamole
steps: brown the ground beef and drain very well return to pan add the taco seasoning and follow the directions on the package when done , drain it again line a 9x13 pan with the tator rounds i only put one layer , but you can put in more follow the instructions on the package and bake when tators are 1 / 2 done , remove from the oven and spread the taco meat on top sprinkle the taco cheese on top of the meat return pan to oven and finish cooking the tators when done serve on plates and add to taste the salsa , lettuce , tomato , sour cream , and quacamole

name: Taco joe dip
ingredients: kidney beans|whole kernel corn|black beans|stewed tomatoes|tomato sauce|green chilies|taco seasoning|onion
steps: in a slow cooker or crock pot , combine all ingredients cover and cook on low for 5-7 hours serving suggestions: serve with tortilla chips spoon over hot baked potatoes roll in a warm tortilla spoon over a bed of lettuce use as an omelet filling add shredded cooked chicken and serve over crushed doritos with a dollop of sour cream

name: Taco joes
ingredients: ground beef|diced tomatoes|worcestershire sauce|chili powder|garlic salt|ground mustard|ground cumin|splenda sugar substitute|hamburger buns|cheddar cheese|lettuce
steps: cook beef in a skillet over medium heat and drain fat add tomatoes , worcestershire and seasonings stir well and bring to a boil reduce heat , simmer , uncovered , for 15 to 20 minutes or until thickened spoon onto buns and top with cheese and lettuce

name: Taco john s potato ole seasoning
ingredients: seasoning|paprika|ground cumin|red pepper
steps: mix all ingredients and sprinkle on tater tots bake as directed

name: Taco junk
ingredients: ground turkey|whole corn|great northern beans|dry ranch dressing mix|diced tomatoes with green chilies|salsa
steps: mix all ingredients together place in a crockpot cook on high for 4 hours it was milder than i thought it would be so next time i would add some taco seasoning , mild green chilies or olives

name: Taco lasagna
ingredients: ground beef|onions|garlic cloves|cheddar cheese|jalapenos|tomatoes|fresh cilantro|pinto beans|corn tortillas|salt|pepper|cumin|chili powder
steps: pre-heat oven to 375 brown the ground beef on med / hi , adding 2t of cumin , a few shakes of salt and pepper , and another 2t of chili powder while the meat is browning , prep the veggies ! the onions and the tomatoes should be chopped down to 1 / 2in or so mince the garlic and cilantro , as well drain and rinse the beans brown the onions and garlic together for 2 minutes before adding in the tomatoes , cilantro and seasonings add the tomatoes , cilantro and 3-4t cumin , 3t chili powder , again , a little salt and pepper and the jalepenos after the tomatoes have begun to really simmer and let out their juices , it's time to turn the heat down to medium while the veggies are simmering , grate the cheese grease your baking pan / dish by now , the veggies are done and you can gather all your bits n pieces together to build your "taco lasagna" layer your casserole , starting with taco , then meat , then beans , then tomato mixture , more tacos , meat , tomatoes , tacos , cheese the order and how much of what goes where is up to whim of the moment , of course bake for 15-20 min or until cheese is bubbling and beginning to brown enjoy with sour cream , hot sauce or sliced hot peppers

name: Taco lasagna made easy
ingredients: ground beef|tomato sauce|taco seasoning|water|salsa|monterey jack cheese|soft taco-size flour tortillas
steps: brown ground beef drain if necessary add taco seasoning , tomato sauce , water and salsa let simmer for about 15 minutes spray a 9"x13" casserole dish with cooking spray put layer of 2 or 3 taco shells overlapping is fine put layer of sauce on top of shells put layer of cheese on top of sauce repeat twice more making sure you leave enough sauce for the top put last layer of cheese on sauce top with green onion bake at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes

name: Taco lasagne
ingredients: ground beef|green pepper|onion|water|taco seasoning|black beans|rotel tomatoes|flour tortillas|refried beans|mexican cheese|cheddar cheese
steps: in a large skillet , cook the beef , green pepper and onion , over medium heat , until meat is no longer pink drain add water and taco seasoning bring to a boil reduce heat , simmer , uncovered , for 2 minutes stir in black beans and rotel tomatoes , simmer , uncovered , 10 minutes heat the refried beans , whether it be just one or two cans , in a saucepan place 2 tortillas in a greased 13x9x2 baking dish pour half of the heated refried beans over the tortillas and then half the meat mixture sprinkle with 1 cup of the mexican cheese repeat the layer top with remaining tortillas and cheddar cheese cover with foil and bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes

name: Taco layer dip
ingredients: guacamole|mayonnaise|sour cream|taco seasoning|cheddar cheese|monterey jack cheese|tomatoes|green onion|green chilies
steps: combine guacamole with 2 tablespoons mayonnaise and layer into the bottom of a 9 x 13" pan mix sour cream , 4 tablespoons mayonnaise , and taco seasoning and spread on top of guacamole layer sprinkle cheddar and monterey jack cheese on top combine tomatoes , green onions , and green chilies and layer over all allow the dip to chill before serving , about an hour should do

name: Taco loaf
ingredients: lean ground beef|onion|green pepper|red pepper|refried beans|diced green chilies|taco seasoning mix|french bread|tomatoes|green onions|cheddar cheese|jalapeno pepper|sour cream
steps: fry ground beef and onion in medium frying pan for about 5 minutes until beef is no longer pink add red and green peppers saut for 2 minutes drain you can skip this step by using recipe #31008 from your freezer add refried beans , green chilies and taco seasoning cook for 2 to 3 minutes , stirring often , until heated through divide and spread beef mixture on each loaf half transfer to ungreased baking sheet divide and sprinkle toppings over beef mixture broil about 8 inches from heat for 1 to 2 minutes until hot and cheese is melted each half cuts into 6 to 8 pieces , for a total of 12 to 16 pieces top each slice with 1 tsp sour cream if desired

name: Taco mac cheese
ingredients: kraft macaroni and cheese|butter|skim milk|extra lean ground beef|taco seasoning|louisiana hot sauce|water|reduced-fat cheddar cheese
steps: make box of macaroni and cheese as directed meanwhile , brown ground beef and drain add taco seasoning / water simmer meat mixture for 5 minutes while simmering , add 1 tbsp hot sauce and 1 tbsp butter mix well drain meat add meat to macaroni and cheese , mix well add shredded cheddar cheese , mix gently 'til melted serve ! yum !

name: Taco mac and cheese
ingredients: ground beef|tomatoes and green chilies|cheese|taco seasoning mix
steps: in a large skillet , cook beef and taco seasoning mix over medium high heat stirring often , until beef is browned and crumbly drain well stir in diced tomatoes and chiles , and keep warm cook macaroni noodles according to box directions drain well return to pan stir in cheese packets and beef mixture serve immediately

name: Taco mac buffalo hot wings
ingredients: butter|durkee's sauce|garlic clove|worcestershire sauce|salt|sugar|chicken wings|paprika|cayenne pepper|vegetable oil
steps: combine hot sauce , butter , worcestershire sauce , garlic and sugar mix well in a pot and warm the sauce until butter is melted keep warm until ready to use if the wings are frozen , be sure to defrost and dry them if they have not been clipped yet , clip the wash them well in cool water season with salt , paprika and cayenne put on a paper towel covered rack / tray in the refrigerator overnight to air dry oil should be about 375 degrees deep fry the wings in batches until just golden , about 10 to 15 minutes or until some parts of the wings begin to turn dark brown remove the wings from the oil to a paper towel covered pain to drain and put in a warm oven while cooking the remaining wings but don't let them sit too long , because you want to serve the wings hot put the wings into a large bowl with lid add the hot sauce put on the lid , then shake making sure to coat all the wings evenly serve any left over sauce on the side serve with bleu cheese dressing and celery sticks dont forget the beer !

name: Taco macaroni
ingredients: elbow macaroni|ground beef|onion|diced tomatoes|condensed tomato soup|tomato sauce|taco seasoning|cheddar cheese
steps: cook macaroni according to package directions meanwhile , in a dutch oven , cook beef and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink drain stir in the tomatoes , soup , tomato sauce and taco seasoning bring to a boil reduce heat simmer , uncovered , for 8-10 minutes or until thickened drain macaroni stir into meat mixture and heat through sprinkle with cheese

name: Taco macaroni and cheese
ingredients: ground beef|water|ketchup|taco seasoning mix|elbow macaroni|velveeta cheese
steps: brown meat in large skillet drain stir in water , catsup and seasoning mix bring to boil stir in macaroni reduce heat to medium-low cover simmer 8 to 10 minutes or until macaroni is tender add velveeta stir until melted garnish with crushed tortilla chips , chopped green onions and tomatoes

name: Taco macaroni and cheese skillet
ingredients: macaroni noodles|ground beef|onion|garlic|green bell pepper|parmesan cheese|salt and pepper|taco seasoning mix|water|butter|flour|half-and-half cream|cheddar cheese|chopped tomato|green onion|sour cream|salsa
steps: in a large skillet brown the ground beef with onions , garlic and green bell pepper until no longer pink , season with salt and pepper drain and add in the parmesan cheese stir in the taco seasoning mix and 3 / 4 cup water bring to a boil and cook stirring occasionally remove from heat in a large saucepan melt butter over medium-low heat whisk in flour until smooth , cook whisking constantly for 2 minutes gradually whisk in milk cook whisking constantly for about 4 minutes or until thickened remove from heat stir in 1-1 / 2 cups cheddar cheese , stirring until melted stir in the cooked pasta and beef mixture mix to combine and cook just until heated through sprinkle with remaining 1 cup cheddar cheese and serve serve immediately with desired toppings delicious !

name: Taco macaroni and cheese with burger
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning mix|elbow macaroni|margarine|water|milk|cheddar cheese|velveeta cheese|sour cream|cream of mushroom soup
steps: brown and drain ground beef and set aside cook and drain macaroni and set aside in a pan , big enough to hold macaroni and burger plus , melt margarine over medium heat slowly add flour while stirring very slowly add water while stirring slowly add milk while stirring add taco mix and stir very well add the cheeses and stir constantly until cheese is melted add sour cream and cream of mushroom soup , stirring well add the macaroni and ground beef , stirring well , until warmed all the through

name: Taco macaroni casserole
ingredients: lean ground beef|macaroni|onion|condensed tomato soup|diced tomatoes|taco seasoning mix|cheddar cheese|monterey jack cheese|tortilla chips|sour cream|green onion
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees f cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente drain in a large skillet , cook and stir ground beef and chopped onion over medium heat until brown mix in tomato soup , diced tomatoes , and taco seasoning mix stir in pasta spoon beef mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish sprinkle crumbled taco chips and grated cheese on top bake for 30 to 35 minutes , until the cheese is melted serve with chopped green onions and sour cream , if desired

name: Taco macaroni salad
ingredients: corkscrew macaroni|ground round|taco seasoning mix|french dressing|lettuce|cherry tomatoes|sharp cheddar cheese|green onion|green pepper|salt and pepper
steps: prepare macaroni according to package directions rinse , drain , and chill for 1 hour in a skillet , crumble and cook the ground round until browned drain add in the taco seasoning and french salad dressing stir to combine let cool in a large bowl , add the macaroni , ground beef mixture , and remaining ingredients stir to combine serve immediately

name: Taco macaroni skillet
ingredients: lean ground beef|water|yellow onion|garlic cloves|diced tomatoes with green chilies|taco seasoning|elbow macaroni|evaporated milk|cheddar cheese
steps: cook onion & garlic until soft add ground beef , brown & drain stir in water , tomatoes , & seasoning cook until mixture comes to a boil add pasta and return mixture to a boil reduce heat to low & cover cook stirring occasionally for 15 minutes remove from heat & stir in evaporated milk & 1 / 4 cup cheese sprinkle remaining cheese on top cover , let stand for 5-10 minutes before serving

name: Taco mashed potato casserole
ingredients: mashed potatoes|cheddar cheese|egg|lean ground meat|onion|cream-style corn|taco seasoning mix
steps: preheat oven to 375f combine potato , cheese and egg and set aside place beef and onion in a skillet over mediun high heat , cook , stirring to break up beef , until beef is browned pour off excess fat , add corn and taco mix , and stir to combine place beef mixture in a 8x8 inch baking dish , top with potato mixture and bake 25-30 minutes

name: Taco meat
ingredients: onions|ground beef|water|anjou pear|taco seasoning mix
steps: get a big skillet and put it on high heat and put the ground beef in the skillet and add your 1 / 4 teaspoon , morton's nature season brown and crumble ground beef and crumble ground beef then when the ground beef get brown cut the onions and add them but the onions have to be chop small then drain the grease or fat out of the pan then when you drain the fat out of the pan put the ground beef back in the pan turn the stove on again and this time turn the heat to low or should i say simmer now add the 2 / 3 cup of water then add the 1 pack of marcum taco seasoning mix mix the real well then turn the heat off spoon full meat into prepared to shell top with lettuce , tomatoes , cheese and salsa

name: Taco meat restaurant style
ingredients: ground chuck|chili powder|ground cumin|garlic powder|paprika|salt|bell pepper|onion
steps: put the ground chuck in a large pot or dutch oven and add seasonings add just enough water to cover the meat , bring to a boil , then reduce and simmer for about an hour every 15 minutes or so break up the meat with a large spoon or a potato masher so that it isn't lumpy be sure always to keep just enough water to cover the meat after an hour add the onion and bell pepper and simmer another 20 minutes the meat should be very finely textured at this point remove from the heat , pour into a strainer over a large bowl , and let the meat sit in the strainer for 10 or 15 minutes to make sure all grease drains away , pressing it a few times after the meat has drained as much as possible , place the bowl of liquid and grease in the freezer for a while when grease separates and hardens on top , take a spoon and remove all of it retain about a cup of the degreased liquid place reserved liquid in a pan and bring to a boil dissolve 1 teaspoon of corn starch in 1 / 4 cup of cold water and add to the liquid , simmering 4 or 5 more minutes add reserved meat into the pan and mix liquid well into meat serve in taco shells or tortillas , or mix into a taco salad or casserole leftovers freeze well

name: Taco meat seasoning
ingredients: chili powder|paprika|oregano|salt|cumin|garlic powder
steps: mix together all ingredients and use the same as you would a packet bought from the store

name: Taco meatballs
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning mix|green onion|eggs|garlic clove|sharp cheddar cheese
steps: preheat oven to 425f mix all ingredients except the cheese together in a bowl mold a tbs of meat around a cube of cheese to form a small shaped meatball repeat with all of the meat spray an edged cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray and place meatballs on the cookie sheet bake for 7-10 min or until meat is done and cheese is melted

name: Taco meatloaf
ingredients: ground beef|egg|ritz cracker crumbs|taco seasoning|american cheese|salsa
steps: combine hamburger , egg , cracker crumbs , and taco seasoning and mix well place half of the meat mixture into loaf pan place three slices of cheese then top off with generous amount salsa and bake in 375 oven for about 35 minute remove from oven and top with with cheese if desired then return for appox 10 more minute or until it's done

name: Taco meatloaf with all the fixins
ingredients: ground beef|diced onion|diced tomato|taco shell|lettuce|shredded cheddar cheese|sour cream|oregano|ground cumin|salt|garlic powder|chili powder
steps: preheat oven to 375 degrees in large bowl mix onion , tomato , taco shells , cheese , oregano , cumin , salt , garlic , chili powder mix in hamburger and incorporate all ingredients , but don't over mix or when it is cooked , it will be tough cook in bread loaf pan for approx 45-55 minutes or cook in square baking pan for approx 30-35 minutes remove from oven place on serving dish and sprinkle with lettuce and dallop of sour cream and enjoy

name: Taco muffins
ingredients: ground beef|water|taco seasoning|butter|sugar|egg|flour|baking powder|baking soda|salt|buttermilk|salsa|cheddar cheese
steps: in a skillet , cook the beef over medium heat until no longer pink drain add water and taco seasoning simmer , uncovered for 15 minutes cool in a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar beat in egg combine dry ingredients add to the creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk fold in meat mixture fill greased muffin cups two-thirds full bake at 350f for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown carefully remove muffins to a greased 13x9-inch baking dish top each with salsa and cheese bake 5 minutes longer or until the cheese is melted makes 16 muffins

name: Taco nacho pizza jack o lanterns
ingredients: rhodes frozen rolls|lean ground beef|taco seasoning|refried beans|mild salsa|taco chips|mild enchilada sauce|cheddar cheese|pepperoni|olive|red bell pepper|green pepper|cheese
steps: spray counter lightly with non-stick cooking spray flatten 1 texas roll or 2 dinner rolls combined into a 5-inch circle repeat with remaining rolls place on large sprayed baking sheets cook ground beef with taco seasoning according to the directions on the packet mix ground beef mixture , beans and salsa together divide evenly between dough circles toss chips with enchilada sauce and spoon evenly over hamburger mixture top with cheese and bake at 350f 20-25 minutes or until edges are lightly browned remove from oven and garnish as desired to resemble jack-o-lanterns

name: Taco nachos rsc
ingredients: white corn tortilla chips|ground beef|hot sauce|red bell pepper|black beans|cherry tomatoes|monterey jack cheese|sour cream|reynolds wrap foil
steps: use reynolds wrap aluminum foil to make a sheet large enough to hold and fold over ingredients spray inside of sheet with cooking spray so the nachos do not stick arrange nacho chips in the middle of the foil sheet top with ingredients above , in that order , except sour cream fold over foil to make a large packet and place on heated grill or grate or over a low burning campfire let cook / steam for about 10 - 15 minutes remove from heat as a top nachos with sour cream and enjoy ! variation: bake nachos in a foil lined baking pan for 10-15 minutes at 350 degrees f

name: Taco nite
ingredients: lean ground beef|ortega taco seasoning|rotel tomatoes & chilies|water
steps: brown and drain ground beef add 1 / 3 cup water and seasoning pkg mix well and let simmer for approximately 3-5 minute add can of rotel and stir well simmer for 5 minutes and serve

name: Taco noodle dinner
ingredients: ground beef|onion|mushrooms|seasoning salt|taco seasoning|fine noodles|tomato juice|hot pepper sauce|sour cream|parsley flakes|cheddar cheese
steps: in a large skillet lightly brown meat stirring to break apart add onion and cook until limp stir in mushrooms and their liquid , taco seasoning , and seasoned salt scatter noodles over the meat mix together the tomato juice and pepper sauce pour over the noodles , pressing noodles down into the liquid cover and simmer for 30 minutes combine the sour cream and parsley , and spread over the top of noodles sprinkle with cheese cover and let stand about 5 minutes

name: Taco noodle dish
ingredients: yolk-free wide egg noodles|lean ground turkey|tomato sauce|water|green chilies|taco seasoning mix|onion powder|chili powder|garlic powder|cheddar cheese|lettuce|fresh tomato|sliced ripe olives|taco sauce|sour cream
steps: cook noodles according to package directions meanwhile , in a large nonstick skillet , cook the turkey over medium heat until no longer pink drain stir in the tomato sauce , water , green chilies , taco seasoning , onion powder , chili powder and garlic powder bring to a boil reduce heat simmer , uncovered , for 5 minutes drain noodles place in an 11-in x 7-in x 2-in baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray spread the turkey mixture over the top sprinkle with cheese bake , uncovered , at 350 for 10-15 minutes or until cheese is melted let stand for 10 minutes top with the lettuce , tomatoes , olives and taco sauce dollop each serving with 1 tablespoon of sour cream

name: Taco on a platter
ingredients: lean ground beef|onion|tomato paste|crushed tomatoes|chili powder|ground cumin|garlic powder|salt|pork and beans in tomato sauce|corn chips|cooked long-grain rice|medium cheddar|red onion|iceberg lettuce|tomatoes|sliced ripe olives
steps: in a large non-stick frying , scramble-fry ground beef and onion until no longer pink and onion is soft drain excess fat add next 6 ingredients , mix well and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes add beans and heat through layer corn chips , rice , beef mixture , cheese , red onion , lettuce , tomato and olives on large platter

name: Taco one skillet meal
ingredients: ground beef|onion|diced tomatoes|long grain rice|taco seasoning|cheddar cheese|lettuce
steps: cook ground beef and onions together until meat is no longer pink drain off all fat drain tomatoes and reserve juice add enough water to juice to make 2 1 / 2 cups add to the pan add tomatoes , rice and taco seasoning and stir bring to a boil , cover and reduce heat to simmer until all liquid is absorbed , about 25 minutes sprinkle each serving with cheese and place lettuce on top

name: Taco or fajita seasoning chipotle or ancho
ingredients: cornstarch|dried ancho chile powder|kosher salt|paprika|onion powder|sugar|garlic powder|oregano|crushed red pepper flakes|cumin|cayenne pepper|fresh coarse ground black pepper
steps: mix all ingredients together and store in a sealed container until ready to use , up to 3 months

name: Taco oven fried chicken
ingredients: nonfat milk|spicy brown mustard|reduced sodium soy sauce|hot pepper sauce|worcestershire sauce|minced garlic clove|flour|reduced-sodium taco seasoning mix|salt|pepper|boneless skinless chicken breasts
steps: whisk together first six ingredients in shallow bowl in another shallow bowl combine remaining ingredients dip chicken in milk mixture , then roll in flour mixture place chicken on baking sheet coated with nonstick cooking spray bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes , or until chicken juices run clear

name: Taco oyster crackers
ingredients: taco seasoning mix|chili powder|italian seasoning mix|garlic powder|oyster crackers|canola oil
steps: put all ingredients in a large tupperware bowl and shake well keep covered until ready to eat !

name: Taco party wings
ingredients: chicken wings|taco seasoning mix|cornmeal|parsley flakes
steps: heat oven to 400 degrees combine taco seasoning , cornmeal , and parsley flakes in a large resealable plastic bag add wings in small batches shake to coat arrange wings in a single layer on two greased jelly roll pans place pans on separate racks in oven bake 15 minutes , then switch pans between racks bake 15 more minutes serve with salsa and sour cream for dipping

name: Taco pasta
ingredients: dry penne pasta|ground chicken|onion|water|taco seasoning mix|sweet peppers|pitted ripe olives|shredded cheddar cheese|salsa|green chili peppers|lettuce|tomatoes
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees , and cook pasta according to directions , and set aside in a large skillet , cook ground chiocken , and onion half at a time , until meat is brown , and drain fat return mixture to skillet , and stir in water , and taco seasoning mix , bring to a boil , and reduce heat simmer uncovered for 2 minutes , stirring occasionally stir in cooked pasta , corn , olives , and half of the shredded cheese , all the salsa , and all the chile peppers transfer mixture to a lightly greased 3 quart rectangular casserole bake uncovered for 35-45 minutesor until heated through remove from oven and sprinkle the remaining cheese serve with lettuce , tomato , tortilla chips , and sour cream

name: Taco pasta casserole
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning|salsa|pasta|cheddar cheese|sour cream|black olives|lettuce
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees cook pasta until done while pasta is cooking brown the ground beef drain ground beef and add taco seasoning per packet directions drain pasta and put into large mixing bowl fold in salsa , 1 / 2 the cheese , and ground meat put into 13x9 casserole dish top with remaining cheese bake for 30 minutes until warmed through - cheese should be melted and bubbly top with sour cream , shredded lettuce , sliced black olives etc whatever you use to top your tacos !

name: Taco pasta pie
ingredients: spaghetti|butter|egg|monterey jack cheese|ground beef|onion|green pepper|tomato sauce|diced green chilies|chili powder|salt|cheddar cheese|sliced ripe olives|tomatoes
steps: cook the spaghetti according to package directions and return pasta to saucepan add the butter and egg mix well and press into a 10 inch pie pan sprinkle 1 / 2 cup cheese over the bottom of the crust bake in a 375f oven for 8-10 minutes in a large skillet , saut the ground beef , onion and green pepper drain off the fat add the tomato sauce , undrained chili peppers , chili powder and salt heat through spoon the meat mixture into the spaghetti shell bake for 15 minutes sprinkle with chopped tomato

name: Taco pasta salad
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning|spiral shaped pasta|tomatoes|green peppers|cheddar cheese|onion|iceberg lettuce|plain doritos|western salad dressing
steps: cook noodles , drain and cool mix taco seasoning into browned ground beef add noodles to meat mixture and cool in fridge overnight the next day , add tomatoes , green peppers and onions just before serving combine all ingredients in large bowl and add chopped lettuce , crushed doritos and dressing

name: Taco pickup sticks snack mix
ingredients: potato sticks|french-fried onions|salted peanuts|butter|taco seasoning
steps: in a large bowl , combine the potato sticks , onions , and peanuts combine butter and taco seasoning mix well pour over potato stick mixture and toss to coat place in three ungreased 15x10x1-inch baking pans bake uncovered at 250f for 45 minutes , stirring every 15 minutes store in airtight containers

name: Taco pie
ingredients: crescent rolls|nacho chip|ground beef|taco seasoning|sour cream|taco cheese
steps: in a pie pan arrange crescent rolls to resemble a pie crust brown ground beef and mix taco seasoning according to package direction on top of crescent rolls , put 1 layer of crushed nacho chips , ground beef mixture , sour cream , shredded cheese , and more crushed nacho chips bake at 325f for 20-25 minutes

name: Taco pie oamc
ingredients: tortillas|lean ground beef|taco seasoning|cheddar cheese
steps: brown ground beef , drain and return to pan add taco seasonning , according to pkg directions in a round cake pan or pir plate , place 1 tortilla cover with 1 / 2 of ground beef mixture sprinkle with cheese cover with another tortilla and repeat meat and cheese layers cover with final tortilla and spirnkle with a little cheese bake in oven at 250 for 20 minutes or until tortilla is crunchy to freeze: cover with foil before baking and place in freezer to cook : remove from freezer , cook covered for 1 hour remove foil and cook for another 15 minutes untill cheese is melted

name: Taco pie in pie crust
ingredients: refrigerated pie crust|ground beef|refried beans|diced green chilies|cheddar cheese|taco seasoning|doritos|guacamole|salsa|sour cream|black olives|tomatoes|lettuce
steps: brown meat > drain fat and season unroll crust , put into 9 or 10 inch pie plate bake crust for about 10 minutes until just starting to bubble spread beans on pie crust layer half of meat , chilis and cheese layer other half of meat , chilis and cheese top with crumbled corn chips bake in 350 degree oven for about 25-30 minutes serve with guacamole , olives , tomatoes , lettuce , salsa and sour cream

name: Taco pies
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning mix|water|olive|crescent rolls|tortilla chips|sour cream|cheddar cheese|lettuce|tomatoes
steps: brown ground beef and drain fat stir in seasoning mix , water and olives simmer 5 minutes unroll cans of crescent dough and press contents of each into 2 10 inch pie plates to form crusts add 1 / 2 cup tortilla chips to each pie , then divide meat mixture& add to each spread meat with sour cream cover pies with grated cheese& additional tortilla chips bake at 375 about 20-25 minutes or till browned and bubbly remove and serve w / lettuce and tomato as garnish

name: Taco pinwheels no black olives
ingredients: cream cheese|meat|cheddar cheese|salsa|mayonnaise|onions|flour tortillas|lettuce
steps: in a small mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese stir in the taco meat , cheese , 1 / 4 cup salsa , mayonnaise and chopped onion thinly spread over tortillas sprinkle with lettuce roll up tightly wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour unwrap and cut into 1 inch pieces can be served with additional salsa makes about 3 dozen appetizers

name: Taco pizza
ingredients: ground beef|refried beans|pizza dough|salsa|taco seasoning|sour cream|cheese|plain doritos|onion|tomatoes|lettuce|black olives
steps: spread pizza crust on to pan and cook for half of the time directed about 10 min brown grown meat and onion drain add taco seasoning as directed on packet then add 1 / 2 cup salsa heat beans remove pizza crust add beans to crust like pizza sauce spread meat mix on top add cheese as much or as little as you like return to oven until cheese is melted remove from oven cut and serve add what ever toppings that you like

name: Taco pizza casserole
ingredients: corn muffin mix|taco seasoning|ground beef|salsa|cheddar cheese
steps: prepare corn muffin mix according to pkg directions -- spread in a greased 8x8" baking pan -- bake at 400 for 6-8 minutes blend 1 / 2 pkg of taco seasoning mix into beef , reserving remaining mix for another recipe -- add any additional ingredients , according to taco seasoning mix directions -- reducing each by half -- remove cornbread from oven and spread with taco sauce -- top with beef mixture and cheese return to oven , continue baking 15 minutes -- longer or until cheese is melted let stand 2-3 minutes , cut into squares to serve garnish as desired

name: Taco pizza with cornbread crust
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning mix|water|mexican blend cheese|green chilies|crushed red pepper flakes|oregano|corn muffin mix|cooking spray
steps: mix corn muffin mix as directed on package spread batter into a sprayed 12-inch pizza pan bake at 400f for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned brown meat and drain add seasoning package , water , and chilies simmer until water is absorbed sprinkle one cup of cheese over crust top with meat mixture sprinkle with crushed red peppers and oregano top with remaining cheese bake until cheese is melted if desired you can also serve with lettuce , sour cream , and diced tomatoes

name: Taco platter dip
ingredients: ground beef|water|taco seasoning|cream cheese|salad dressing|canned diced green chiles|roma tomatoes|green onion|lettuce|taco sauce|cheddar cheese
steps: in a large skillet cook beef over medium heat until it is no longer pink , drain add green chiles , water and taco seasonings stir simmer for 5 minutes cool in a large bowl combine cream cheese and salad dressing spread on a 14 inch serving platter or pizza pan top with cooled meat mixture sprinkle with tomatoes , onions and lettuce drizzle with taco sauce sprinkle with cheddar cheese serve with tortilla chips

name: Taco pollo spicy chicken filled tortillas
ingredients: chicken breast fillets|garlic cloves|red onion|tomatoes|green capsicum|olive oil|chili powder|flour tortillas|cheddar cheese|flat leaf parsley|lemon wedge
steps: cut the chicken into thin strips , peel and crush the garlic , peel and slice the onion , de-seed and roughly chop the tomatoes and deseed and slice the capsicum into strips heat the oil in a large pan or wok , preferably non-stick and fry the chicken over a high heat , stirring for 2-3 minutes until it is starting to brown add the garlic and onion and fry for another 2 minutes stir in the chilli powder , tomatoes and capsicum and cook for 2-3 minutes , stirring , until the chicken is cooked through preheat the grill to medium , grill the tortillas for 6 seconds on each side , or until warm transfer them to a work surface and spoon equal amounts of the chicken filling onto the centre of each tortilla and roll up tightly transfer the filled tortillas to an ovenproof dish and sprinkle with cheesse cook under a hot grill for 2 minutes , or until golden garnish with parsley and lemon and serve

name: Taco popcorn
ingredients: popped popcorn|butter-flavored cooking spray|cumin|garlic powder|onion powder|worcestershire sauce|cayenne pepper
steps: preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit put popcorn in a large mixing bowl lightly coat popcorn with cooking spray toss and coat again combine cumin , garlic powder , onion powder , and cayenne pepper sprinkle spices over popcorn and toss to coat evenly drizzle worcestershire sauce over popcorn and toss again spread popcorn evenly in large baking pan bake for 10 minutes , tossing once

name: Taco potato shells
ingredients: baking potatoes|butter|ground beef|diced tomatoes|taco seasoning|cheddar cheese|sour cream|green onions
steps: scrub and pierce potatoes bake at 375f for 1 hour or until tender cut potatoes in half lengthwise carefully scoop out pulp , leaving a thin shell brush inside and outside of potato shells with butter place cut side up on an ungreased baking sheet bake , uncovered , at 375f for 20 minutes meanwhile in a skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink drain add tomatoes and taco seasoning bring to a boil reduce heat simmer , uncovered for 20 minutes spoon into potato shells sprinkle with cheese bake , uncovered , 5- 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted top with sour cream and onions

name: Taco potato skins
ingredients: russet potatoes|butter|taco seasoning|cheddar cheese|bacon|green onions|salsa|sour cream
steps: cut each potato lengthwise into quarters with a spoon , scoop out the pulp , leaving a 1 / 4 inch shell and discard pulp in a small bowl , mix together the butter and taco seasoning brush butter mixture over both sides of the potato skins place skin side down on a greased baking sheet sprinkle with cheese , bacon , and onions bake at 350 degrees for 5 to 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted serve with salsa and sour cream

name: Taco potatoes
ingredients: potatoes|butter|salt|chili powder|cumin|paprika|oregano|garlic powder|onion|sour cream|parsley
steps: cut cooked potatoes into bite sized pieces and place in large baking dish cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over potatoes combine all other ingredients except sour cream and parsley and sprinkle over potatoes heat in 350 degree oven until heated and butter is melted serve with sour cream and parsley as a garnish

name: Taco quarter pounders
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning mix|ketchup|milk
steps: mix all together and shape into 6 patties grill or fry until desired doneness serve on toasted buns with your favorite taco toppings on the side

name: Taco quiche
ingredients: flour tortillas|ground beef|onion|garlic|green chili|chili powder|salt|oregano|cumin|monterey jack cheese|eggs|sour cream|chopped tomatoes|lettuce|black olives
steps: line a greased 13x9x2 baking dish with the tortillas , tearing to fit if necessary cook the meat and onion in a skillet drain off excess fat add garlic , chilies , and seasonings spoon the mixture onto the tortillas sprinkle with the cheese beat eggs well and then blend in the sour cream pour this mixture on top of the meat and cheese bake in a preheated oven set at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes let sit for 5 minutes before topping with the lettuce , tomatoes and olives

name: Taco ramekins
ingredients: lean ground beef|chili powder|salt|pepper|baking mix|cold water|tomatoes|green pepper|sour cream|mayonnaise|cheddar cheese|onion
steps: in a skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink drain stir int he chili powder , salt and pepper remove from the heat and set aside combine biscuit mix and water to form a soft dough press onto the bottom and up the sides of two 10-oz ramekins or custard cups coated with nonstick cooking spray fill with meat mixture top with tomato and green pepper combine the sour cream , mayonnaise , cheddar cheese , and onion bake , uncovered at 375 for 20-25 minutes or until heated through

name: Taco red potato salad
ingredients: red potatoes|vegetable oil|cider vinegar|sugar|taco seasoning mix|whole kernel corn|black olives|fresh cilantro|green onion
steps: mix the seasonings in a jar and shake shake shake pour over potatoes and toss to coat cover and refrigerate to chill and meld flavors when ready to serve , mix in the corn , olives , cilantro , onion , and anything else your heart desires

name: Taco rice
ingredients: ground beef|onion|garlic cloves|taco seasoning mix|rice|cheese|salsa|lettuce|tomatoes
steps: brown ground beef in skillet over medium-high heat add onion and garlic when it is almost cooked through , or not very much pink left cook till meat is done add taco packet seasoning follow directions on packet as to how much water to add and how long to simmer when meat is done put over rice in either one big bowl or in individual bowls top with salsa and sprinkle with cheese , lettuce , and tomatoes , and whatever other toppings you wish enjoy !

name: Taco rice oamc
ingredients: ground beef|onions|taco seasoning mix|diced tomatoes with juice|cooked rice|cheese|chopped tomato|olive|sour cream|guacamole|salsa|green onion|cilantro
steps: containers: 4 gallon sized freezer bags assembly directions: brown meat and drain combine meat , onion , taco seasoning packets , cooked rice and tomatoes in saucepan simmer until thick- about 30 minutes freezing and cooking directions: cool , label , and freeze in gallon sized freezer bags also freeze a ziptop bag with 2 cups of shreaded cheese for each meal to serve: thaw completely preheat oven to 350 degrees place in a casserole dish and bake until heated through about 30-35 minutes top with shredded cheese and bake about 5 minutes longer

name: Taco ring
ingredients: crescent roll dough|ground beef|chili powder|ground cumin|refried beans|cheddar cheese|salsa|lettuce|tomatoes
steps: brown meat with chili powder and cumin drain well roll out dough and pull apart at perforations arrange triangles in a large circle on a pizza or baking sheet scoop 1 / 2 hamburger meat on dough , forming a circle about 1 1 / 2 inches inside dough ring sprinkle 1 / 2 cup of cheese over meat fold outside dough over meat to form a "stuffed crust " fill center with refried beans , remaining meat , and remaining cheese bake according to directions on dough package when pie is finished , pull out and immediately decorate with lettuce , tomatoes and salsa enjoy !

name: Taco ring from pampered chef
ingredients: lean ground beef|taco seasoning mix|shredded cheddar cheese|water|refrigerated crescent dinner rolls|bell pepper|salsa|lettuce|tomatoes|onion|black olives|sour cream
steps: cook ground beef in large skillet over medium heat 7-9 minutes or until beef is no longer pink drain remove pan from heat stir in taco seasoning mix , cheese and water preheat oven to 375f unroll crescent dough separate into triangles arrange triangles in a circle on classic round pizza stone with wide ends overlapping in center and points toward outside i use my pampered chef pizza stone , but any flat round pan should work--perhaps even a pizza sheet , but i'd spray it with pam before adding the crescent rolls scoop meat mixture evenly onto widest end of each triangles up over filling and tuck under wide ends of dough at center of ring bake at 20-25 minutes or until golden brown shred lettuce and chop tomato , onion , olives , and bell pepper if you want to do something fancy , scoop out a bell pepper and fill with salsa and put into center of ring add your toppings to top of ring and finish with more shredded cheese and sour cream this is great with a salad

name: Taco ring my version
ingredients: crescent rolls|taco seasoning|refried beans|lean ground beef|cream cheese|hot sauce|salsa|lettuce|tomatoes|sour cream|olive
steps: unroll all crescent dough sections place in a circle , on a baking sheet or stone , with the short ends facing in and the same direction overlapping by almost half it will look like a fancy sun spread the refried beans around the circle and a little up each dough section if possible just make sure the layer is fairly thin you may want to season the beans with salt at this point if they are very plain brown the groud beef add the taco seasoning and the cream cheese and mix thoroughly until the cheese melts then add the salsa and heat until some of the liquid evaporates add the hot sauce spoon the beef mixture over the refried beans if you dare , add a little more hot sauce at this point ! to close the circle , bring each point of each crescent roll section in to the center and tuck under the ring to secure i use a metal spatula to make this step easier and to prevent messes bake the taco ring in a preheated 350 degree oven for about 30 minutes or until the crescent dough is golden brown serve with the optional fixings , if you like

name: Taco ring pampered chef
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning|cheddar cheese|water|crescent rolls|green pepper|salsa|lettuce|tomatoes|onion|black olives|sour cream
steps: preheat oven to 375 brown ground beef and drain off the grease combine ground beef , taco seasoning , cheese and water unroll crescent rolls , seperate into triangles arrane triabgles in a circle on 13" baking stone with wide ends overlapping in center and points towards outside using medium stainless steel scoop , scoop meat mixture evenly onto widest end of each triangle bring points of triangles up over filling and tuck under wide ends of doughat center of ring (filling will not be completely covered bake 20-25 minutes cut up the rest of the veggies and prepare to top your taco ring when done baking

name: Taco ritos
ingredients: ground beef|refried beans|cream of mushroom soup|green enchilada sauce|flour tortilla|monterey jack cheese|cheddar cheese|onion|diced tomato|lettuce|sour cream|guacamole
steps: brown ground beef and drain off grease add refried beans remove from heat soften tortilla in microwave for 20-25 seconds place 2 tbspns of ground beef mixture and 1 tspn of onion on tortilla and roll like a burrito place in shallow roasting pan repeat filling and rolling instructions until you fill approximately 8 tortillas mix mushroom soup and green chile enchilada sauce together and pour over rolled tortillas in pan top with both cheeses bake in 375 degree oven for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and everything is hot allow to stand about 5 minutes serve with toppings , as desired

name: Taco roll ups
ingredients: lean ground turkey|taco seasoning mix|water|corn|refried beans|flour tortillas|salsa|cheddar cheese
steps: crumble the ground beef into a large skillet and brown over medium-high heat when the meat is cooked , drain the fat add the taco seasoning , water , and corn stir and simmer the mixture for 3 minutes turn off the heat and stir in the refried beans to give the filling a smooth consistency , pour the beef mixture into a blender or food processor with 4 or 5 short pulses , eliminate any large chunks from the mix for each wrap , heat a tortilla in the microwave for 10 seconds spread about 1 / 2 cup of the beef mixture evenly over it , then top with a layer of salsa and cheese roll it up and tuck in the ends tightly cover each sandwich in plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 24 hours cut in half at serving time or cut into 1 inch slices for appetizers

name: Taco roll ups
ingredients: flour tortillas|cream cheese|sour cream|black olives|green chilies|green onion|sharp cheddar cheese|garlic powder|taco seasoning mix|refried beans|lettuce|chopped tomato
steps: in a large bowl combine the cream cheese , sour cream , olives , chilis , onions , cheese , garlic and taco seasoning mix mix well lay our your 6 flour tortillas on a clean surface and evenly divide the cream cheese mixture spread evenly over the surface of each tortilla add equal amounts of refried beans on top of each tortilla and spread evenly if using shredded lettuce and tomatoes add now roll and place on a plate seam side down cover with plastic wrap and chill for at least 1 hour remove from fridge and slice into 1 inch rounds serve

name: Taco roll ups oamc
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning|water|frozen bread dough|cheddar cheese
steps: brown ground beef and add taco seasoning and water cook for 5-10 minutes set aside roll thawed dough into a rectangle - about 20 x 8-inches spread ground beef over dough - leaving about 1-inch of dough on one long edge free of filling top beef with grated cheese roll up as for cinnamon rolls starting with the long edge closest to you pinch seam to seal slice the roll into 1-inch thick slices with a serrated knife place rolls 2" apart onto a cookie sheet that has been sprayed with cooking spray if any filling falls out just press it into the top of the rolls bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until golden brown serve with salsa , sour cream or guacamole for dipping to freeze: allow to cool completely flash freeze and then place in a ziploc bag when firm label , seal and freeze to serve: thaw in fridge overnight or thaw / heat in microwave about 45 seconds on high

name: Taco rolls
ingredients: whole wheat tortillas|reduced-fat cream cheese|taco seasoning mix|black olives|jalapenos
steps: mix the cream cheese , olives , seasoning , and chopped jalepenos very well spread the mixture evenly on the tortilla wraps roll up the rolls tightly refrigerate them in a ziploc bag for at least 30 minutes after the rolls have set in the fridge cut them into 3 / 4 inch slices eat them plain or dip them into salsa enjoy !

name: Taco salad
ingredients: ground beef|lettuce|tomatoes|green onions|kidney beans|cheddar cheese|taco chips|taco seasoning|coleslaw dressing
steps: scramble fry ground beef until cooked and no pink is showing in a sieve , run under hot water to remove any excess fat add all ingredients together refrigerate until ready to serve when ready to serve , toss salad well with just enough coleslaw dressing to coat top with crushed taco chips

name: Taco salad jean dalponte
ingredients: hamburger|red kidney beans|lettuce head|red onion|tomatoes|cheddar cheese|taco chips
steps: cook and drain 1 lb hamburger wash and drain red kidney beans refrigerate both for at least 1 hour chop lettuce , tomatoes and onion mix together in a large bowl add chilled hamburger , beans , cheddar cheese , crushed taco chips before serving add bottle of dressing

name: Taco salad low carb
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning|iceberg lettuce|tomatoes|avocado|cheddar cheese|salsa|sour cream|ranch dressing
steps: brown the hamburger drain off the fat stir in the seasoning mix allow to cool place lettuce , tomato , avocado and cheese in a large bowl blend the salsa and sour cream together add ground beef to the bowl toss salad with desired amount of dressing and serve

name: Taco salad our way
ingredients: ground turkey breast|baby greens|taco seasoning|black pepper|garlic|sugar snap pea|grape tomatoes|broccosprouts|four-cheese mexican blend cheese|salsa|sour cream|corn chips|black olives|jalapenos
steps: brown turkey and season with taco seasoning , black pepper and garlic to taste on each plate spread desired amount of greens evenly layer cooked turkey , peas , tomatoes , sprouts , and cheese in desired amounts then top with salsa for dressing garnish with sour cream , black olives , jalepenos / green chiles and corn chips as you wish enjoy ! )

name: Taco salad a little switched up super yummy
ingredients: tortilla chips|red kidney beans|salsa|ground beef|mild cheddar cheese|lettuce|tomatoes|ranch dressing|onion
steps: brown the ground beef with a handful of chopped onion and drain add light red kidney beans and jar of salsa simmer for about 30 min on med low heat to assemble place chips on plate , on top of that add some beef salsa mixture then put cheese and other toppings you like top all of it with ranch dressing enjoy !

name: Taco salad bowls
ingredients: whole wheat tortillas|chili powder|extra lean ground beef|carrot|salsa|miracle whip|salad greens|tomatoes|tex-mex cheese|fresh cilantro
steps: preheat oven to 425 crumble 4 large sheets of foil to make 4 3" balls and place on baking sheet place one tortilla on top of each ball and spray with cooking spray sprinkle evenly with 1 / 2 tsp chili powder bake 6-8 min or golden tortillas will drape over balls as they bake meanwhile brown ground beef with carrots and remaining chili powder in large skillet add salsa and cook 2 min or heated through mix miracle whip and 2 tbsp salsa in large bowl add salad and tomatoes and toss to coat spoon into tortillas , top with meat , cheese and cilantro

name: Taco salad dinner
ingredients: ground turkey|taco seasoning|cheddar cheese|salad greens|tortilla chips|catalina dressing|taco sauce|sour cream|tomatoes|green onion|red onion
steps: in a skillet brown ground meat drain well rinse if desired add taco seasoning and follow instructions for that recipe or package set out all the optional toppings you would like and let everyone make their own plate , using whatever toppings they want

name: Taco salad dip
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning|cream cheese|sour cream|lettuce|cheese|black olives|chopped tomato
steps: brown ground beef drain add taco seasoning , according to pkg directions blend cream cheese and sour cream spread on serving tray or in 9x13 glass dish sprinkle meat on top of cream cheese / sour cream mixture add lettuce , tomatoes , olives and cheese serve with tortilla chips , doritoes , etc

name: Taco salad dip 2 and sour cream topping
ingredients: lean ground beef|refried beans|tomato sauce|taco seasoning|onion|green pepper|cayenne pepper sauce|garlic|lettuce|tomatoes|cheddar cheese|green onion|frito corn chips|sour cream|chili powder|cayenne pepper
steps: brown ground beef in skillet add minced garlic , diced onion and diced green pepper cook for 5 minutes add refried beans , tomato sauce , seasoning mix and pepper sauce and heat until it bubbles spoon mixture in a 8x8 baking dish and top with 1 / 2c shredded cheese in a small bowl mix together sour cream , 1 / 4c shredded cheddar cheese , chili powder and cayenne powder mix well and spoon over top of taco meat mixture top with shredded lettuce , tomato and chopped green onions serve with fritos

name: Taco salad dip for a party
ingredients: cream cheese|salsa|black beans|frozen corn|iceberg lettuce|green pepper|red pepper|vidalia onion|cheddar cheese|tortilla chips|corn chips
steps: in kitchen aid mixer whip the cream cheese , add the salsa blend well place this mixture into the bottom of a 9x13-inch glass baking dish layer all the ingredients except the tortilla chips / frito's into the pan serve with chips

name: Taco salad dressing
ingredients: tomato soup|white sugar|worcestershire sauce|salt|vegetable oil|cider vinegar|garlic|cumin|pepper
steps: mix all ingredients in a sauce pan simmer 15 min cool , bottle and refrigerate

name: Taco salad for a crowd
ingredients: lean ground beef|ketchup|dried oregano|chili powder|salt|pepper|head iceberg lettuce|tomatoes|taco cheese|sliced ripe olives|mayonnaise|taco sauce|corn chips
steps: in large saucepan , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink drain stir in the ketchup , oregano , chili powder , salt and pepper bring to a boil reduce heat cover and simmer for 10 minutes in large bowl , combine the lettuce , tomatoes , cheese , olives and beef mixture combine mayonnaise and taco sauce pour over salad and toss to coat sprinkle with corn chips serve immediately

name: Taco salad from cousin pam
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning mix|salad greens|kidney beans|black olives|sharp cheddar cheese|grape tomatoes|plain doritos|catalina dressing
steps: brown ground beef in a skillet , drain , then add taco seasoning mix and whatever amount of water the package calls for cook meat per directions on taco seasoning mix package , then refrigerate meat put lettuce in a great big bowl , then add the beef , beans , olives and cheese and mix / toss really well just before you plan to serve this , add the tomato chunks and crushed up doritos and mix them in pour in the bottle of dressing , mix everything one more time , and serve

name: Taco salad ii
ingredients: lean ground beef|green bell pepper|onions|garlic granules|salt & freshly ground black pepper|chili powder|ground cumin|process american cheese|tomatoes and green chilies|head lettuce|tomatoes|tortilla chips
steps: crumble and brown meat well in a skillet over medium-high heat drain excess grease , and add green pepper , onion , granulated garlic , and salt and pepper to taste cook a few more minutes , and add chili powder and cumin in a small saucepan , melt cheese over low heat stir in tomatoes with green chilies , and season to taste with salt and pepper in a large bowl , layer in the following order , lettuce , tomatoes , chips , hot meat mixture , and hot cheese mixture toss at the table , and serve immediately

name: Taco salad pasta bake
ingredients: ground turkey|pasta|green bell pepper|red bell pepper|taco seasoning|salsa|water|fat free sour cream|fat-free cheddar cheese
steps: begin by preheating the oven to 375 add about 2-3 cups of water to a medium pot and bring to boil add pasta and cook until desired tenderness while pasta is boiling , add peppers to a large saucepan and saut over medium heat for 5-7 minutes remove the peppers from the pan and add the meat cook over medium heat until lightly browned , stirring often add water and taco seasoning to the meat and reduce heat to low stir frequently , and let this simmer until the mixture begins to thicken add salsa and peppers back to the mixture and remove from heat when pasta is cooked , remove from heat and drain combine pasta and meat mixture and place in a 9x13-inch casserole dish bake for 20 minutes turn off oven , sprinkle cheese on the top and place back in oven for 5 minutes divide the dish evenly among 4 plates and top each with 1 tbsp of sour cream time to enjoy !

name: Taco salad supreme
ingredients: ground beef|taco seasoning|water|green chilies|pinto beans|lettuce|tomatoes|cheese|onion|plain doritos|black olives|jalapeno
steps: brown beef and drain grease add green chilies , pinto beans , taco seasoning , and water cook for about 8 minutes in a big bowl put in rest of ingredients and mix or layer it if you wish then add meat mixture and mix again top it off with some nacho chips serve with sour cream or taco sauce

name: Taco salad tortilla bowl
ingredients: flour tortillas|olive oil|salt|pepper
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees lightly brush tortillas with oil sprinkle with salt and pepper to your liking press tortilla into the ovenproof bowl bake about 13 minutes transfer tortilla to a cooling rack and repeat with remaining tortillas fill with your taco salad and listen to your guests rave !

name: Taco salad waffles
ingredients: ground beef|salsa|green chilies|taco seasoning|frozen waffles
steps: in a large skillet cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink drain stir in salsa , chilies and taco seasoning bring to a boil reduce heat simmer for 5 minutes meanwhile , toast waffles according to package directions spoon about 1 / 4 cup beef mixture onto each waffle if desired top with cheese , lettuce , tomatoes , avocado , salsa or sour cream

name: Taco salad with beans
ingredients: black beans|taco seasoning|water|lettuce|red peppers|tomatoes|olive|corn chips|cheddar cheese|reduced-fat thousand island dressing
steps: heat beans , water and taco seasoning in small sauce pan over medium heat , stirring occasionally until heated toss lettuce , bell pepper , tomatoe , olives and chips in large bowl spoon bean mixture , cheese and drizzle dressing over lettuce mixture and toss serve immediately

name: Taco salad with everything
ingredients: lean ground beef|taco seasoning|head iceberg lettuce|sweet onions|tomatoes|green pepper|frozen corn|black olives|cilantro|nacho cheese flavor doritos|ranch salad dressing|avocado
steps: in a very large mixing bowl , combine all ingredients except doritos and salad dressing toss to mix well toss in crushed doritos----toss well gradually mix in salad dressing to desired moistness place in a very large serving bowl and garnish with avocado slices and some cilantro best if served right away

name: Taco salad wow
ingredients: green leaf lettuce|corn|kidney beans|black olives|nacho cheese flavor doritos|cheddar cheese|catalina dressing|ground beef|taco seasoning
steps: brown ground beef add taco seasoning and cook according to directions on seasoning pack drain liquid from corn , kidney beans , and black olives for parties where salad will go fast , mix all ingredients , except the nacho doritos , together well and serve crush a hand full of nacho doritos and sprinkle over salad if you are planning on eating salad throughout the day , or serving up leftovers the next day , store all ingredients in separate containers and mix in individual bowls for serving this will keep the lettuce and chips fresh and crisp

name: Taco salad wraps
ingredients: lean ground beef|salsa|chili bean|worcestershire sauce|onion powder|chili powder|garlic powder|pepper|flour tortillas|lettuce|plum tomato|cheddar cheese|baked corn tortilla chips
steps: in a small nonstick skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink drain stir in 1 / 3 cup salsa , beans , worcestershire sauce , onion powder , chili powder , garlic powder and pepper bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , for 5 minutes spoon meat mixture onto each tortilla layer with lettuce , tomato , cheese , crushed tortilla chips and remaining salsa roll up

name: Taco salads
ingredients: thousand island dressing|ground beef|water|chili powder|salt|garlic powder|ground red pepper|kidney beans|lettuce|cheddar cheese|sliced ripe olives|tomatoes|avocado|sour cream|onion
steps: prepare thousand island dressing if you are making it from scratch cook beef in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until brown drain stir in water , chili powder , salt , garlic powder , red pepper , and beans heat to boiling reduce heat simmer uncovered 15 minutes , stirring occasionally cool 10 minutes mix lettuce , cheese , olives , tomatoes , and onion in a large bowl toss with thousand island dressing add beef mixture and toss divide on serving plates garnish with avocado and a dollop of sour cream serve immediately cover and refrigerate any remaining salad

name: Taco sandwich
ingredients: italian bread|cream cheese|salsa|ground beef|taco seasoning|lettuce|tomatoes|american cheese
steps: cut bread in half lengthwise hollow out the top and the bottom , leaving a 1 / 2-inch shell in a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and salsa until well blended spread inside the bread shell and set aside in a large skillet , cook ground beef over medium heat until no longer pink pour off grease stir in taco seasoning layer lettuce and tomato in bottom of bread shell top with beef mixture and cheese replace bread top

name: Taco sauce
ingredients: tomato paste|water|cayenne pepper|chili powder|salt|cornstarch|white vinegar|dried onion|canned jalapeno slices
steps: combine the tomato paste with the water in a large stainless or enamel saucepan over medium heat stir until smooth add the cayenne , chili powder , salt , cornstarch , and vinegar in a food processor puree the onion and jalapeno until smooth add to tomato water mixture and bring to a boil , stirring often once you have reached the hard boil stage cook for 3 minutes , then remove from heat let stand to cool place in a tightly sealed container and place in the fridge this will keep up to 2 months if you wish to can this product you pour the hot liquid into clean , sterile hot half pint jars and process in a boiling water bath for 20 minutes

name: Taco scramble
ingredients: popcorn|tortilla chips|butter|taco seasoning mix
steps: in a large bowl , mix popcorn and tortilla chips stir seasoning mix into melted butter pour seasoned butter over popcorn and chips gently stir until well coated cool before eating store in airtight container

name: Taco seasoned meat and potatoes
ingredients: frozen hash browns with onions and peppers|ground beef|salsa|water|taco seasoning mix|colby-monterey jack cheese|cooking spray
steps: in a medium skillet over medium heat , brown ground beef drain and return to skillet add taco seasoning and water stir until water is absorbed , about 5 minutes add salsa , mixing well with cooking spray , coat a 8 x 11-inch dish spread half of potatoes evenly over bottom of dish then spread half of ground beef mixture over potatoes sprinkle with half of the cheese repeat layers ending with cheese bake at 350f for about 25 to 30 , or until cheese is a nice golden brown

name: Taco seasoning
ingredients: ground beef|water|garlic powder|onion powder|dried oregano|ground cumin|paprika|salt|black pepper|cayenne pepper|jalapeno
steps: brown the beef add seasoning add 5-1 cup of water simmer for 30 minutes or until most water is dissolved

name: Taco seasoning salt free
ingredients: cumin seeds|ground cinnamon|garlic powder|onion powder|chili powder|cayenne pepper
steps: place all spices in a zip top bag or jar with a tight fitting lid shake well use 1-2 t per pound of meat

name: Taco seasoning budget friendly seasoning for tacos burritos
ingredients: chili powder|paprika|cumin|oregano|garlic powder|onion flakes|cayenne pepper|salt
steps: mix all spices together store in airtight container will keep for 6 months to a year 7 teaspoons of this spice mix is the equivalent of one 1 25 oz packet of store bought taco seasoning this recipe makes the equivalent of 4 spice packets to make tacos- mix 7 tsp to 1 lb ground meat that has been browned and drained of fat add 3 / 4 cup water and stir to blend cook til water has evaporated

name: Taco seasoning hcg friendly
ingredients: chili powder|onion powder|cumin|garlic powder|ground pepper|paprika|oregano|sea salt
steps: combine ingredients and store in air-tight container or plastic sealed bag great to use when cooking organic grass feed beef or extra lean ground beef

name: Taco seasoning blend
ingredients: dried onion flakes|cornstarch|chili powder|ground cumin|dried garlic|hot pepper flakes|beef bouillon powder|dried oregano
steps: combine all in a container with tight fitting lid for tacos add 3 tbsp of mix and 1 / 4 cup water to browned beef

name: Taco seasoning mix
ingredients: chili powder|dried oregano|salt|cinnamon|cayenne pepper|cumin
steps: mix together and use in place of a package of taco seasoning mix

name: Taco seasoning mix gluten free
ingredients: potato starch|chili powder|paprika|salt|onion powder|cumin|cayenne|garlic powder|sugar|pepper
steps: mix spices together for each pound of ground beef , browned add one recipe of mix plus 3 / 4 cup of water , simmer for 10 to 15 minutes use the recipe calculator to make a larger recipe to mix and store for future use i then use approximately 2 1 / 2 to 3 tablespoons mix per pound of hamburger

name: Taco seasoning packet for the frugal home maker
ingredients: dried onion flakes|chili powder|basil|oregano|parsley|garlic powder|cumin|water|salt & pepper
steps: tear off a 4-inch strip of aluminum foil , then tear the rectangle in half to have a roughly 4x4 square or use a snack-size zipper bag dump all spices & herbs in a small pile fold foil edges up , pressing folds firmly to seal tightly store in a cool dark container at serving time: sprinkle packet contents over browned hamburger , add water simmer lightly , cover with lid to allow onions to re-plump after about 7 minutes , check if water has simmered off and if onions are plumped up if not , add another tablespoon , and continue plumping we prefer our taco / enchilada meat a bit juicy , but you may wish to remove the lid and let it dry before serving uses: tacos , taco salad , burrito , tostada , enchilada , mexican lasagna

name: Taco seasoning reduced sodium gluten free
ingredients: chili powder|paprika|ground cumin|onion powder|garlic powder|dried oregano|cornstarch|cayenne pepper
steps: combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight-fitting lid close securely , and shake well to mix contents to make tacos , brown 1 lb of ground beef or turkey in a skillet add two tablespoons of taco seasoning , salt and pepper to taste , and 1 / 2 to 1 cup water simmer until sauce reduces and thickens serve in taco shells with cheese , chopped tomatoes , and shredded lettuce for toppings

name: Taco shell bake
ingredients: jumbo pasta shells|hamburger|taco seasoning|cream cheese|rotel tomatoes|cheddar cheese|fritos corn chips
steps: cook noodles until they are still firm brown hamburger and drain add taco seasoning , cream cheese and 1 / 2 of can of tomatoes to hamburger stir well when noodles are cooled down , add cheddar cheese to hamburger mix and stuff shells put into a greased casserole dish over top put rest of tomatoes and sprinkle with cheese add crushed fritos bake at 325 degrees in oven for 20-25 minutes until cheese is melted and chips are golden makes about 25-30 shells

name: Taco shells
ingredients: corn tortillas|cooking oil
steps: drape tortillas over individual rungs on oven rack bake at 400 degrees until crisp carefully remove the taco shells and allow to cool

name: Taco shepherd s pie
ingredients: ground beef|butter|onion|taco seasoning mix|frozen corn|mashed potatoes|cheese
steps: preheat oven to 350f cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender , about 20 minutes drain potatoes and mash as usual heat 1 tablespoons butter in saute pan add onion , and saute for 5 minutes add ground beef , and cook until beef is lightly browned drain off any excess fat add taco seasoning mix and cook as per package directions remove from heat place meat mixture into ovenproof casserole cover with corn cover with mashed potatoes sprinkle with grated cheese bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes , or until potatoes are light golden serve

name: Taco shortcakes
ingredients: boneless pork shoulder|taco seasoning mix|refried beans|velveeta cheese|corn muffins|lettuce|chopped tomato|sour cream|fresh cilantro
steps: put the trimmed pork shoulder in a crock pot sprinkle with taco seasoning , and spoon the beans on top of pork and seasoning cover and cook on low for about 8 to 10 hours remove pork from the crock pot and place on a cutting board take 2 forks and shredded the pork return the shredded pork back into the crock pot and stir everything well stir in the velveeta cubes , and let it melt to serve - split the corn muffins in half place the bottom of the muffin on a plate and put about 1 / 2 cup of the pork mixture on the muffin bottom top with a little bit of lettuce and tomato , and then replace the muffin top serve with the sour cream , and sprinkle with cilantro if you want

name: Taco shrimp filling
ingredients: medium shrimp|lime juice|taco seasoning mix|garlic powder|salt|chipotle chiles in adobo
steps: heat a skillet over medium heat add shrimp and all the rest of the ingredients to skillet and cook until shrimp are pink served over couscous but would be good served in tortilla's

name: Taco skillet burgers
ingredients: egg|milk|soft breadcrumbs|onion|taco seasoning|ground beef|condensed bean with bacon soup|water|tomatoes|sharp american cheese|corn chips
steps: in bowl combine egg , milk , bread crumbs , onion and taco seasoning add ground beef mix well shape beef mixture into 6 patties in a large skillet lightly greased brown patties on both sides mix soup and the 1 / 2 cup water spoon this over the patties cover skillet and cook over low heat for 15 minutes top with tomatoes and cheese cover and continue to heat for another 3 minutes serve with the broken corn chips

name: Taco skillet dinner
ingredients: hamburger|taco seasoning|water|macaroni|cheddar cheese|sour cream|tomatoes
steps: brown and drain hamburg add taco seasoning , water and raw macaroni bring to boil , then reduce heat to medium low and simmer until noodles are tender , about 8-10 minutes serve with cheese , sour cream and tomatoes i used one envelope of taco spice , but i'm not sure of the size it looks like about 1 teaspoons

name: Taco snack mix
ingredients: shredded wheat cereal|pretzel sticks|tortilla chips|taco seasoning|margarine
steps: combine cereal , pretzels , tortilla chips , and taco seasoning in a large bowl drizzle with the melted margarine and toss well store in an airtight container

name: Taco soup
ingredients: kidney beans|corn|lean ground beef|ranch dressing|taco seasoning|tomatoes|onion
steps: brown hamburger and onion , drain combine all other ingredients in a large pan add hamburger and onion cook mixture for about 30 minutes , bringing then to a boil remove from heat , cool and serve you can also add some doritos to the recipe for a taco salad style

name: Taco soup gluten free
ingredients: ground beef|diced onion|minced garlic cloves|diced green chilies|whole kernel corn|hominy|chicken broth|ranch style beans|rotel diced tomatoes|diced tomatoes|taco seasoning|dry ranch dressing mix
steps: brown meat in extra large pot and do not drain the meat you need all the space for the soup you will want to cook the diced onion and garlic into the meat before adding all the other ingredients open all cans and packages and dump them into the pot with the meat bring to a simmer and cook for 1 hour makes great left overs and freezes wonderfully

name: Taco soup oamc
ingredients: lean ground beef|onion|diced green chilies|taco seasoning|hidden valley ranch dip|corn|stewed tomatoes|pinto beans|kidney beans|fresh cilantro|monterey jack cheese
steps: brown the meat with the onions in an 8-qrt stockpot when cooked all the way through , add remaining ingredients and cook over medium heat for 30 minutes eat now if you are not freezing it top with grated cheese , sour cream , tortilla chips , etc if freezing , let cool completely and pour into freezer bags first mark the bags with "taco soup , reheat to serve" and the date i usually let the bag partially thaw , enough to get it out of the bag and then heat over low until warmed through

name: Taco soup paula deen
ingredients: ground beef|onions|pinto beans|red kidney beans|whole kernel corn|mexican-style stewed tomatoes|diced tomatoes|tomatoes and green chilies|diced green chilies|black olives|green olives|taco seasoning mix|ranch dressing mix|corn chips|sour cream|cheese|green onion|jalapeno
steps: brown the ground beef and onions in a large skillet drain off excess fat and transfer browned beef and onions to a large slow cooker or stockpot add the beans , corn , tomatoes , green chilies , black olives , green olives , taco seasoning and ranch dressing mix simmer over low heat for about 1 hour to serve , place a few corn chips in each bowl and ladle soup over them top with sour cream , cheese , green onions and jalapeos

name: Taco soup the easiest
ingredients: hamburger meat|onion|white corn|black beans|pinto beans|kidney beans|water|rotel tomatoes|diced tomatoes|taco seasoning mix|ranch dressing mix
steps: brown meat with onion and drain grease add all ingredients to pot cover and simmer for 45 minutes to an hour

name: Taco soup crock pot
ingredients: hamburger meat|ranch style beans|whole kernel corn|stewed tomatoes|ro-tel tomatoes|ranch dressing mix|taco seasoning
steps: simmer all ingredients in a crock pot on low for 7 to 8 hours when ready to serve , top with grated cheese and tortilla chips

name: Taco soup ii
